Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics, friend?
While serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country.**** And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**

subject: At the start of the general election — is there ANYTHING I can say to convince you to make a split donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate?

body:

Friends, it’s Ruben Gallego here.

I know we’ve sent a number of emails your way. But with our primary election over and the general election kicking off, I hope you understand that we’re not doing it to annoy you.

We’re sending them because emails like this are one of the single, biggest ways we fund a campaign that can win.

And today, I am asking if there is anything, anything at all that I can say to convince you to chip in to my campaign.

**What if I told you that this will be one of the most closely contested, most expensive, most decisive elections in the entire country** this year — and that we MUST win to hold the U.S. Senate?

**What if I told you that Trump attacked me — personally, by name — during a rally with my opponent, Kari Lake?** If we’re going to defeat Trump and stop him from retaking the White House, it starts right here in Arizona.

**And what if I told you that your support really, truly matters.** Seriously. I’ve seen what this team can do, and on the first day of the general election with less than 100 days to go until the most important election of our lifetime, your donation is absolutely critical to our success.

Please. A lot of people have already chipped in to help us reach our goals and they’re hoping you'll do the same. We are, too. **My opponent Josh Hawley, the guy who raised his fist then ran away on January 6th, really thinks he’s some kind of tough guy, Peter.**
He’s made a whole career out of trying to control other people. And he has the most extreme anti-freedom record on reproductive rights of any member of the U.S. Senate — on abortion, birth control, and even IVF.
He’s become obsessed with convincing all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man. Last year, he published a whole book about it: _Manhood: The Masculine Virtues America Needs._ It’s all about how we should be made in his own creepy image.
**You just can’t make this stuff up:**

Wade, taking real action to protect critical reproductive healthcare like birth control and IVF, and standing up to anyone who gets in my way.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I focused on campaign admin work at home as my wife was in the hospital with a kidney infection for much of it. Thank you so much for the well wishes so many of you sent us. She's out of the hospital now and is feeling much better. I did manage to text 120,000 4th District voters, and had a number of great conversations. I also got some good family time in with my kiddo. Also, for any hospital connoisseurs out there, and I know there are many, the Webster City Hospital is pretty nice. Really cheap Mountain Dew and a nice garden were positives.
On Friday, I was able to get out and do some door knocking and sign dropping in Story and Boone Counties. Saturday, I attended the county fair Democratic party booths in Kossuth and Woodbury Counties, and on Sunday, I attended the Woodbury County Fair again, marking my last county fair visit until the Clay County Fair in September
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Poverty and other kitchen table struggles came up quite a bit on the campaign trail. I was doing some reading on that front, and came across a December 2023 article I'll post below that reported the wealthiest 1 percent of Americans now have more wealth than the middle class, which is typically considered to be the middle 60% of households by income.
To me, that's indefensible. Immoral. Unsustainable. Considering over 60% of Americans are struggling paycheck-to-paycheck, this is not a situation in which a rising tide is sufficiently lifting all boats. In the article, it struck me there was no discussion of the decades-long attacks on unions, attacks that have succeeded in whittling away workers' rights and creating a greater and greater gap over time between productivity and wages. We have the most productive workers here, and they deserve to be paid accordingly. If elected, to help address this issue, I'd focus on getting the PRO Act passed to protect collective bargaining rights while getting the federal minimum raised from its unacceptable $7.25, among other things.
In Iowa news, we continue to see more and more companies shipping jobs overseas. So often, these companies are price gouging us and masking it in the name of inflation, while accepting tax abatements on the front end to plant factories here, only to leave our communities in the lurch in the pursuit of cheaper labor overseas. I'm an advocate of a windfall tax to address this price gouging, and want to explore options from the federal level to keep our jobs here.
Our schedule for this week: On Wednesday, 8/7, I attended a voter forum with Dem. state house candidate Ryan Condon and Dem. state senate candidate Mike Wolfe. I also invited my opponents Randy Feenstra and the Libertarian Charles Aldrich. Feenstra, unsurprisingly, didn't respond, while Charles attended. It was nice meeting him. On Thursday, 8/8, I'll be speaking at the annual Wing Ding in Clear Lake in the evening. On Saturday 8/10, I'll be attending the CCI Convention most of the day in Ankeny, learning about the state's water quality issues, the threat posed by the eminent domain-abusing carbon capture pipelines, and other pressing concerns. I'll be speaking at the Des Moines Register Soapbox at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines Sunday 8/11 at 130 pm, and will be doing various interviews with journos. I'll also eat some fair food. I have to support the local economy, of course.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2023/12/06/top-1-american-earners-more-wealth-middle-class/71769832007/
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

Peter, yesterday, I was in Philadelphia with Governor Walz for our first rally of this election. Since the day I announced my candidacy, I set out to find a partner who can help build a brighter future for our country. **And I have found that partner in Tim.** He is a _leader_ who will help unite our nation. A _fighter_ who will support the middle class. A _patriot_ who will preserve the promise of America. _Now, Peter, are you ready to stand by our side and fight for our future?_ [**I am asking for a donation of $25 or more to power our campaign today. subject: Purple heart veteran: US looks like war zone
body:
As a US Army combat veteran, I’ve seen violence up close and personal.

Dear Patriot,
As a US Army combat veteran, I’ve seen violence up close and personal.
I’ve watched as my fellow soldiers were gunned down in front of me.
I’ve taken multiple gunshot wounds myself.
I’ve seen things that would make the biggest, toughest guys you know cry for their mommies.
War is hell.
That’s why it breaks my heart to watch my own country – the country I love, the country I bled for...
Turning into a violent, crime-ridden war zone.
But that’s exactly what's happening.
Over the past few years, violent crime has skyrocketed...
And I don't mean to scare you, but I believe it could soon get MUCH worse.

subject: Protect parental rights against the new Biden-Harris Title IX rules
body:
I wanted to alert you to an issue that critically affects free speech in schools and the privacy rights of all students.

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z5o0j85cq5l4in5bvem4u9qrah5ao94t3ne73lqo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chi61ob2c5h2bs)
---
| |

Dear Friend of Liberty,

I wanted to alert you to an issue that critically affects free speech in schools and the privacy rights of all students.

The Biden-Harris Administration's new Title IX regulations redefine "sex discrimination" to include all forms of gender identity, leaving anyone who disagrees to be punished for speaking up for their beliefs, physical safety, and privacy.

We've stepped up to fight these regulations. We strongly believe in the right to free speech, and allowing students to express their beliefs without fear.

[**That's why we're supporting Moms For Liberty in their courageous legal challenge against these new Title IX rules.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zng7aqcs8qntubshbkk4hitu03ddllforo86fuao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chi61ob2c5h2bs)

This battle is not just about regulations; it's about safeguarding our children's privacy and your parental rights.

We need your immediate support. Will you sign our petition today?

[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/moms-for-liberty-petition/](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zdjhbert5q873kb28u158p4enm938grh6f3g2c2g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chi61ob2c5h2bs)

# Many Reasons for Hope
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter,
Our nation and the world face many problems today, some of which may seem overwhelming, but there are still reasons for hope. I'm running for Congress because I don't like the direction our country is headed. Open borders, crime, inflation, drugs, violent assaults, failing schools, contention in the Capitol, and a myriad of other problems have most Americans saying we are headed in the wrong direction. It can all sound quite bleak, but change starts with hope - the hope that you and I can still make a difference. Anne Frank wrote in her diary, "How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world." During a NATO assignment to Europe, I visited the home where Anne Frank wrote these words. Talk about bleak; Anne and her family had lost everything and were hiding from evil Nazis who wanted to capture and kill them. Yet, she was able to find reasons for hope. You and I have many more reasons to have hope. Despite our problems, we still live in the greatest country on earth. Prophets foretold of this "promised land" of freedom and opportunity. You and I have the privilege of deciding if we will "improve the world." It is as simple as being kind to someone, starting with our family, neighbors, and community. This is why I chose to run for the House of Representatives. According to our constitution, the President represents the entire country; senators represent their respective States. But it is the members of the House of Representatives who represent the people. As a Congressman, I can improve the world one person at a time. As one of 435 voices in Congress, I will fight to fix our country. I will not be able to solve all our nation's problems alone, but I can improve the lives of the people I represent in Boulder City, Henderson, and the east side of Las Vegas. If someone's Social Security check is missing - I'll represent them. If someone is having difficulty getting their Veteran benefits - I'll represent them. It will be my job to make sure the Federal government is working for the 750,000 people within Nevada's First Congressional District. To do this, I will be home in Henderson every weekend and whenever Congress is not in session. I will have a robust staff of caring people who live and work here in Southern Nevada. I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my District. Join Me in This Mission
We have a chance to make a real difference. As Ronald Reagan said, "You and I have a rendezvous with destiny. We will preserve for our children this, the last best hope of man on earth..." Your support is crucial. Every effort, whether volunteering, spreading the word, or donating, brings us closer to restoring our country's direction. Please reply to this email if you are willing to support our campaign. Together, we can change the direction of our country and bring positive change to our community and our nation. Thank you for your commitment and support.
*******

name: CIntel on behalf of Hillsdale College
subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsRP15VWNo

Hillsdale College

Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey
on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osRP15VWNo

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your National
Survey on the United States Supreme Court using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63453701:sRP15VWNo:m:3:2532013465:9071F5BD93A88DB67F31523B57108EEE:r

And after you give your views, I hope
you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's
schools to provide young people with a proper education in
American history and government makes it easier for progressives
to undermine the separation of powers at the heart of limited
government.

I'm sure you agree that too many
Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary
in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty
nationwide, directly reaching and teaching millions of Americans
in all 50 states-including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of
anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across
America.

Your support will help us to expand our
educational outreach, including:

Teaching millions of citizens
nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution
101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S.
Supreme Court."

Reaching over six million
households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's
free digest of liberty.

Sending millions of pocket-size
copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and
students in K-12 schools across America.

Restoring excellence to K-12
education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70
classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong
American history and civics curriculum.

We undertake our educational outreach
efforts on behalf of liberty-as we do all of our work-without
accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work-including
reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of
liberty-depends entirely on the support of Americans like you,
who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with
Hillsdale using the College's National Survey on the United
States Supreme Court right away-the link is below.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63453701:sRP15VWNo:m:3:2532013465:9071F5BD93A88DB67F31523B57108EEE:r

Then please consider giving a generous
tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations
through education.

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty
since 1844

Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI
49242 USA

subject: Purple heart veteran: US looks like war zone
body:
As a US Army combat veteran, I’ve seen violence up close and personal.

Dear Patriot,
As a US Army combat veteran, I’ve seen violence up close and personal.
I’ve watched as my fellow soldiers were gunned down in front of me.
I’ve taken multiple gunshot wounds myself.
I’ve seen things that would make the biggest, toughest guys you know cry for their mommies.
War is hell.
That’s why it breaks my heart to watch my own country – the country I love, the country I bled for...
Turning into a violent, crime-ridden war zone.
But that’s exactly what's happening.
Over the past few years, violent crime has skyrocketed...
And I don't mean to scare you, but I believe it could soon get MUCH worse.
If you want to keep your family safe, [you need to see this](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyU0MGK6yAUxvGnMbsEPccmunBxuSW73kUpFO5GjJ42UtMENZ15_KED8wCz__Px47ue7MnFFJ_3f24hU3O1udi8WPpcw17a2eXQ1rV9xJQscJAtVy1XFptg5AAB-4aMGACFkEqLZjZeSeR4EMKF20HLIfSkwmHiygk9IOommvcOV1xxLXvADr3gFHong4ReeM0kd4lyLV2dKdO2Tyl696zkls6vS5PMXOtWGP5hMDIYa350OMcQ6Hlbs6fyrhiM8i9cjwODETT-l-d3jGNZ9-zJxsDwmN2LQV_2STA8Em3rxhUXICd7PtnL-WJ_oE02YfuIKcXSD0zy--Ji-rbU31z2MvAVAAD__-XbcVU).
I’m recommending every American patriot take one specific action TODAY to prepare for a coming wave of crime, violence and chaos.
And I explain exactly what it is in [this short, uncensored video](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyU0MGK6yAUxvGnMbsEPccmunBxuSW73kUpFO5GjJ42UtMENZ15_KED8wCz__Px47ue7MnFFJ_3f24hU3O1udi8WPpcw17a2eXQ1rV9xJQscJAtVy1XFptg5AAB-4aMGACFkEqLZjZeSeR4EMKF20HLIfSkwmHiygk9IOommvcOV1xxLXvADr3gFHong4ReeM0kd4lyLV2dKdO2Tyl696zkls6vS5PMXOtWGP5hMDIYa350OMcQ6Hlbs6fyrhiM8i9cjwODETT-l-d3jGNZ9-zJxsDwmN2LQV_2STA8Em3rxhUXICd7PtnL-WJ_oE02YfuIKcXSD0zy--Ji-rbU31z2MvAVAAD__-XbcVU).

## Terror Plot Threatens Taylor Swift Concerts
Taylor Swift's three concerts in Vienna, Austria, scheduled for August 8-10, were [canceled due to an alleged terrorist plot](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQxvGnsbuxYExsUlBc4y7XXmkRGGJOGCKYDcrbr7L1dp_0az79_932m40p5sdfe5LhUHbrOL5o16AB1a5GbwIR0jySkSvOEpWQOB4G5XWVznuvUAexLnciqy8KV9I6rOTGaFCgElpoKcQicJqVnRf0elZq8foaBiXIRy51-l9i5oNCepcX1cmVc0zmYH62Yf4z4Dbg1nuf8t1l6u3jA26f-YFSkx9wY_tOpULrMTC4kh1VBqZaS4VnKgz2q3GNFkKJiTwgnJTB1kqNyUM7Sm_Qobps5XK5XOVYjX_2mFJsyzoo8ThtTD_f-NdQL4PfAQAA___viWzG) targeting the events.Austrian police arrested two men, [including a 19-year-old Austrian](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwjAQRn9NshnZ58Mxg4cubHTtGF2SM1zlEGQfUP59Redu36e3PL2v03giKXI9f9LKSfM20qzy4DGaaABH7JeUmYF9z8kN4B2gddBf0jSwJ4qEw8AOQsT9cCC7BOeQPS6hlwQW0EYbnbXBws4j-QBL9IhhiYfcoeVFdKu7702ueuFcXtuD627e1r6ki-qtdf6jg2MHR7pd-dne6H2qylz4ve5Nq5DhH628SlsN1cpNm2k836voyyi9ylZNe0pWM_DMdoKAOTC6PUwRHM6HPFGcEfZTX9Nye0op0sLQoT2vJOVPSP-t80jwGwAA__9YoGa3) citizen, who allegedly pledged allegiance to ISIS, and are searching for additional suspects.Chemical substances were found at one suspect's home, and police believe the planned attack was [aimed at events in the Vienna area](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQxvGnMduh43DAHTx0YUvXjuhiH4lbx0bGAaVPX6Vz1-9bfvp_nuczhxjS9YPvYuuSZ3Y17DIbMEB61o23iwhJ34jtRuo70thRc7OmH8Q5c0HSF0eCtJy0O8mAfBo7T2MTLCFpNGg6xAGp7TX3A3nTaz1487YojeJDzaX9yiHVmyzxmXcprcv3Jtpbreum-ndFk6LpOI62yKNK2V7_a8klekWTPEpeRdFU-Rlzge0IS4U9SEoMLicnpW7gODmJUTz4h8AaOSXxwLWy-4ZcrpzCjxTY-LnByw1oAEdFU1OsX48QY9iGUWm83jnEP2L9t9du6TcAAP__ngRuMg).About 170,000 ticketholders will receive automatic refunds within ten business days for the canceled Austrian concerts.
## White House Says Gaza Ceasefire is Close
A ceasefire and hostage [release deal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL8Gd0R4PMG4oLjGXa690pqYIUwOm8iwifL3q0299ZPek96_y3IhybLf_tLGvsWy0NrkyYvTTgMu2AUfmYGHjn0_wtADmh665K-EOJ2tiwZpcNdxRTvaMcYVJzvROXTiwQAaZ1xvjDVwGpAGC8ENiDa4KSo0HKSV43QvsrfEMb_Lk4_TWrYu-9Tao6rhj4JZwdwSJ8n5hymYHyXL-lYwB468V1Ywo-ttPzr9StJYp_JVWd9L2vV_Oa5vLfUgzjrRRlW_6NArU2Ud5WAdmLJec_l4usOHx0tylmpHhea2kXyyXfv1z9PDdwAAAP__755now) between Israel and Hamas is "as close" as it has ever been, according to White House officials. Speaking to the press, national security spokesperson John Kirby didn't offer a timeline for the ceasefire but said the details needed to be "hashed out." On Tuesday, Sec. of State Antony Blinken [described the negotiations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQxvGnsTuiYRhjUlBcky7XXmkNMMSccBwZkmjffpWtt_z0NT_9_12XK5da7re_vInveV849vKSxSmnkBYak88iKGYUr2c0Ggk0jqtPrEMUgGCJAXPMMpkUNU5AYXJyHotHQAIHTgNYwJMhNhaTM0Q2uXMeCCSVvh-n_3u591Vy_dpfcpzivo3Vr70_2mD-DHgZ8MKPu7zb5_qMo5dYZcBLaQdLVStv3NSbD1W5S-tqVvy8PVtXH4OaOKZZm5jA2BDIxhCTzhYBgEOiPB4-Pd6l1tLsPBDcNi71h9F_bfLy-B0AAP__SV1iDg) as being in the final stages, stating that the newly chosen Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar had the power to ensure that a ceasefire deal is reached.Tensions in the Middle East remain high, despite ongoing talks. On Wednesday, [Egypt and Britain instructed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGypCAQheGnwawtbFhkAoJNzGbTDS2UduxdFAsYrXn7W974pv9Jvjp_n-PTc-T99cdv5OqSRj9XPmm0YAH1qJvgFiIk1ZDrelQdatlhszolA_ZK_iLVycngbOhhp26ZJlr6SRls2KFELa20nZRGYqu0VwaDVVqbYB-L0JIC15Tbf4n3utISP-mk3M5pa6Jbaz2KUL8FDgKH67raTO9Kudz7XVKOQeCwcQiRgHypAgd6fY4KvvwvwLWA5xx5pwL-TByAs9_vBuXwM0FdMxGs6Z0L1PWdS_AfuNUgLche4NBkF46LY-RieqHla_Mcv4H1x7dOh18BAAD__2xCbO0) their airlines to avoid Iranian and Lebanese airspace, reflecting growing fears of a broader regional conflict following the death of Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh last week.

| | August 8, 2024 Today I'm honored to announce that Joe Markley has endorsed my candidacy for the Republican nomination for Congress in Connecticut's 4th District. Joe is a former 4-term CT State Senator from Southington, and has always been known as one of the most principled and effective conservative voices in the Capitol.
---
---
---
Joe and I have known each other for 15 years. We met during the tea party movement's earliest days, organizing rallies and events state-wide. In 2010 he won election to the senate, where he carried on the fight for constitutional governance under the Capitol's dome. I appreciate Joe's support for my candidacy and his principled Endorsement.
After 16 years, you can help us return true Representation to the solid citizens of CT-4, by retiring Jim Himes back to private life.
I would be honored by your vote in the Aug. 13th Primary. I'm the CT-GOP Endorsed Conservative. Vote for me on row 'A' of your ballot. Let's finally end the Jim Himes chapter and return the citizens of CT-4 to their rightful seat at the table. Help is on the way! In liberty,

## Cruz Endorsed By Prominent Democrat
U.S. Sen. Ted Cruz [received the endorsement](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu8yAURp_GbFiATQwDw79ky792tC7c6wQVmwhoSPv0VTJ3_z6do_NxWS8QUzyu_2En155bXiG0-KDVcMPVvM4MnRdoJSMnFzVJaU9WspszmrQGGWCzapq0F8bMZiODPuAmPLDolFCzMMJIoU9KjmbRFi1KuWjUQS3DLAhjy2VsN2r0hLql7_ygMoa8s-Rurd3rMP0b1HlQ5977eFCvnejzNRjU-f3hSHsOBRqnA3OpVHkj5KF8_fBCvsCB3Mc7lBYrHFzaSVujWXF47zGlWE8vkesOMb257e8KD6d-AwAA__9loWD9) of a prominent Democrat on Tuesday: Harris County District Attorney Kim Ogg. She cited Cruz's focus on [combating violent crime](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9utDAQBPCnMZ1PXhvzp3DxNXT3tSmRsffACrAneyF3efqI1KlHGv1mPu7j3ac17fN_v6Hj14NGHzidOHayk7oe6yq6ScUeKnTQagPQNz1UiwsdWgCjGmNUE6MxMfZaTcF24dGghSo5rXStOtWBso2GW9faPvYRoLXRBt2KWmFMTPnGCzK-fHmsbzox3wJt1eoW5mcR5p_Qg9CDnwKYKxF6eFJhoQfGKEM-viXTwUXiHikX3HBnuficU5GBjp3fMqbCOQWWnpnyjm_5mTZJ8ywXOgrTLiNuFLJnOaWrk0q5IPIkxiL0ABYsGOiFHqrs4vMrrWsqzTVh3nxaf8X893-n0z8BAAD__zaSdOQ) as transcending partisanship, referencing the June murder of 12-year-old Jocelyn Nungaray by illegal immigrants in Houston. Ogg has clashed with fellow Democratic county leaders and won't be on November's ballot after [failing to win](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGv4yAQBOBfY3cbwQYCFBTXuHvXXhkRWMfoYRPBJk7u15989etGGmmkb_58Xb9CLnm7_w4reX7P9Roi5xddLVhAdVVj8jeRnBzJS4NnKd3FyXHx0qLQwhmbpJFO4ezodpZCzxTsHEMas0eBSlhhpdAXlCdrtEsuSWl00hHNoASlzLWdeCGmd-hz-dQXtVOs61j8wvzow_nXgNOA077vp--lPo9ywCk0zrHQgNNGex9wetSSOccjLqG13CHW58YfSLlzy5EhMNe20Qe-8wr1fgfaUm2dOjAliO35FzptgQlaiMcyWg0mJuXU7QakbQDlJIIVMwKas3AJFSa6jM2nx55Lyf1yqO5ryOU_gn--9OXxXwAAAP__NH94HQ) her party's support in this year's primary. Cruz touted the endorsement from Ogg and several other Democrats in an effort to peel voters away from challenger Collin Allred in what is shaping up to be a close race.
## Hospital Sued For Rescinding Job Offer
A physician assistant is [suing Texas Children's Hospital](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO2zAQRL-G6miQa0mUChVp1F3alMaaXJmb0KRAbqy7fH0g19cMMMAAD29-fdw-kBPnx0980iKfW7mhF37RbdKThv7Wd2G5mzDbjhbr4GrtPM62i8sYfAjgyBlyFK69o2Gc8e4nZ4xFgI4XMNCbyUzWDCPYy-SGOczBWjeEwYNTvaHAUupFIgl9YtvSV3lRvfjy7NISRfamrj8UrArW4zguPrH_A7H8bVLyuVKwZjqagjUVj0nBejIVrGY6Y1Sw7vGrsWfMGlvjJphFl22jSkH_LneNot9s7SOnUCk3HUvbWTDpA5uWkoKWSJXeFXXkyvmht0r0jzRuQlVXOvnC-aFg7eoS9oNT4jaeko8ncno7yfcPvxb4HwAA__8HzICO) for $400,000 after relocating her family from California based on a job offer that was later rescinded due to a hiring freeze. Mojgan Pedram claims she was hired in April, moved in late May, and was then informed the [job was on hold](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvwyAUBOBfY29Y8IJtGBi6eEvXjhbm4fhVGCIgsfvvq0Qdu9-dPt3Xdb5aChRvn3b3pp5rmq2r9PSzYoqBnGWLZuGoReuNGOEihB60aDfDpdRWwWhRw2J7FLgM6qJGh3YQuMqWDHCQXHEleD-A6NTYa9QoxNhj72BsJPdINeWubr7605Y1_KSnz51LexvMVuu9NJePBqYGpuM4ujWdMGzpUWqKr1ADU_RHaWB615nbKGD2sbAtlTtVG1iwR3lQZS5Y2gvLvjiKSPHGvtPC0rr6zLIPydlKKbK_8TYbvB8UApXh5bztlsKbVf8_6WngNwAA__8l-W3K) despite the hospital being aware of the freeze for two months prior. On Tuesday, Texas Children's, the state's largest pediatric hospital, announced layoffs for [5% of its workforce](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOrCAUxvGnwQ4DR1EpKKahm3vLLQ0rB2EXxQCrM2-_mam3_pIvv_w_7vPdhBj29Z_ZUNWHS7NZajhxnuhEoZ_7xqpPZiVvUPEROs7lIHnjVY_CgetAikEMo3V9NzHHHI4IzHBpmqCAQc8mNnEmBuDtNApppeV8FFYsMJKeoQ015bZ6rPgwxcVnOjG3S9qaqHytRyHdjYAmoK_rareyvzYCGnf6UwhojyZWT0Cn6jET0O8fuvgQbca9UJ_KEaqJNJpn2FeanKMunEgPzAvulSZHQy30SvnbpbwgAW0yvd14iv-_ziYre1whxlCGF3jdTIhvX_271qngNwAA___ZaG5u), around 1,000 employees. Executives blamed the cuts on declining patient volumes and unforeseen operating costs.
## Survey: Texas Teachers Are Underpaid, Unhappy
A survey by the Texas State Teachers Association and Sam Houston State University found that 65% of teachers seriously considered [leaving the profession](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLHO2yAURp8Gb1hwAYMHhi7e_q4drWu4xKjERIbG6dtXydDpn4_06Tvn19f6hbnk4_YT7-T7K9UVQ89PWh13HPSqh-g3EWc5kJcWlJTzNMth91uAOMcJrBACJ7lZJFTGoDbOBavTkD0I0MIJJ4WZQI7OmjnOUUproglgmRYUc6_n2Hfq9MKWyt_6pHMM9T4Uv_f-aEz9YLAwWK7rGq-E-IYMFjx7DoUYLAddjcFC8U_AnuvBYPmM8U4Ydjob_494w55behvWg28YfvNeeQt7rYXBAs5yPVmdYFNcCRO5TkQco1GcEkllNJJV03D6-LhyKblNb4vbHXP5nO7fJ3x6-BcAAP__kd5yiQ) last year. The study revealed widespread dissatisfaction among educators, with 57% believing the public doesn't have a positive opinion of them. Texas teachers earn an average of $62,463, about [$9,000 below the national average](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQxvGnMZuRfTHGDB6ysKVLInVEB3cES06MjEOSt69Sdez2bb9P_-_TcMIQw_36hTf25TWnAacSdh6cdBLMYCryo6JOV-x1CwetO9vpavGII2p3oE7bljSMIzg0xs6GeCK0qgoeFBjllNOqsaBr1zYddaR121AzQSuMYgol5bosXPiF2xzfaedcT-lWRb-Usm7icBTQC-jLVrBO-Sqgf65ySvfC9yKgf6wxIW0C-g8noFfubyunrLycL0d5YZwWzvKUMkaW50fe-V2vNFfZ0_oMMYbNfv5cbxjiL1_-j7F7-AkAAP__Zy9fXw). The survey revealed that 33% of teachers rely on second jobs during the school year to make ends meet.

# Protect Your Money Before It's Too Late
---
|
---
Chuck Norris here... I've spent my entire life as a proud American. America has been a great place to live, work, and raise a family. But right now, I'm deeply troubled at what I see happening to our nation--and what the future may hold for our children and grandchildren.
---
| | **Just take a look around.**
---
* We're **$34 Trillion** in debt
* Inflation is running **over 3%**
* A recession is on our doorstep
* And the people in charge keep spending our money.

---

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](http://trk.libertyledger._G7teo5dLSdW3fmeK68w)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://trk.libertyledger.-xOxEjibA)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](http://trk.libertyledger.--rrKW1xlP2gpFhyQ)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 8/8/2024
body:
Euthanasia at area animal shelters is up by double digits as thousands of Coloradans surrender their dogs
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey everyone,
I've been sharing lots of great info over on [X/Twitter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Come join me there! This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 8, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Euthanasia at area animal shelters is up by double digits as thousands of Coloradans surrender their dogs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Colorado’s animal shelters have reached a tipping point.
Dogs that once were adopted within days are now waiting weeks or months and some never make it out. While many shelters have “no-kill” policies, those policies don’t apply to dogs that are unhealthy or unsafe.
According to the National Canine Advocacy Group, the six largest shelters along the Front Range took in just over 42,000 dogs last year and euthanized nearly 5,000 of them; a 24% increase over 2022.
Now, the state’s oldest shelter is turning some dogs away. The Dumb Friends League has long billed itself as a “socially conscious shelter,” accepting all unwanted animals – but as dog surrenders soar and adoptions fall, Dumb Friends is suspending its open door policy.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Rep. Boebert: ‘It’s now truly MAGA vs. Marxism’ in presidential race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Lauren Boebert has criticized Kamala Harris's choice of Tim Walz as her running mate, claiming the Democratic Party is shifting further left, and framing the election as "MAGA vs Marxism."
* She controversially labeled the Democratic Party as the "Hamas Party" in reaction to Harris not selecting Gov. Josh Shapiro, implying anti-Semitism influenced the decision.
* Boebert likened Tim Walz to Bernie Sanders, labeling him as an "avowed socialist," which aligns with her narrative of the Democrats' shift to the left.
* Closing her comments, Boebert linked current economic issues directly to Harris, arguing against her policies and warning against re-electing the current administration, suggesting that it would prolong economic downturns.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In continuing saga, judge lifts order, allowing adversaries possible vote to remove GOP chair; Dueling meetings might exist again](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Colorado district court judge reversed a temporary restraining order, clearing the way for a vote on whether to remove Colorado Republican Party Chairman Dave Williams.
* After losing a legal battle, Republicans opposed to Williams immediately scheduled a meeting for August 24 to potentially oust him, while Williams declared this meeting "invalid and illegal."
* The judge's decision emphasized that internal party disputes should be resolved within the party, not through judicial intervention.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[State’s minimum wage could increase by nearly 3% again in January](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's minimum wage, including in Denver, Edgewater, and Boulder County, will increase on January 1, 2025, with adjustments for inflation based on the Consumer Price Index.
* Denver’s minimum wage will rise to $18.81 per hour, the state's to $14.81, Boulder County's to $16.57, and Edgewater's to $16.52.
* Some local businesses, particularly in hospitality, are concerned about the financial impact of wage increases, including reduced staff hours and possible closures.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Wolves from Washington a no-go because Colorado failed to agree on concerns of Southern Utes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Confederated Tribes of the Colville Nation withdrew their offer of 15 wolves to Colorado, citing a failure by Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) to engage in meaningful consultations with the Southern Ute Tribe and other impacted tribes regarding wolf reintroduction plans.
* The Southern Ute Tribe has expressed longstanding concerns about the impact of wolf reintroduction on their land and hunting rights, dating back to opposition stated in a 2020 resolution due to potential effects on wildlife and livestock.
* Despite the setback with the Colville Tribe, CPW remains committed to moving forward with its wolf reintroduction plan and continuing discussions with tribal entities to address concerns and foster cooperation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[How long could the ballot be? Nine propositions could make ballot, eight others missed ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado voters will decide on several ballot measures in November, including initiatives that address property tax limits ([Proposition 50](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), abortion rights ([Proposition 89](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), and the prohibition of hunting certain wildlife ([Proposition 91](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)).
* Some measures are still pending signature verification, such as [Proposition 108](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (property assessment rates), [Proposition 112](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (parole eligibility for violent crimes), and [Proposition 310](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (establishing a ranked choice voting system).
* A number of proposed measures failed to qualify for the ballot, including those concerning gender incongruence in schools ([Proposition 142](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), telehealth services for veterinarians ([Proposition 144](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)), and prohibitions on ranked choice voting ([Proposition 201](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)).
* The signature threshold for ballot measures requires at least 5% of the total votes cast for Secretary of State candidates in the last election, amounting to 124,238 signatures this year. Additionally, constitutional amendments require signatures from at least 2% of registered electors in each of Colorado's 35 Senate districts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fabbricatore: Why I am running for Colorado’s 6th District in Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I constantly hear how difficult it is for a Republican to win the seat in the 6th Congressional District in Colorado. It’s been a tough battle for many years, but this seat was held by Republican leadership since 1983, represented by former Congressmen Daniel Schaefer, Tom Tancredo, and Mike Coffman._
_The tide turned when Democrats, determined to take this seat, committed significant financial resources to Jason Crow’s campaign, spending more than $5 million. At that time, it became one of Colorado’s most expensive races, with nearly $23 million being spent by both candidates and outside groups._
**[LISTEN HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Tina Peters Trial Recap: Elections manager breaks down on stand, defense focuses on inconsistencies in state’s case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Previously elected Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters is facing seven felony charges and several misdemeanors in a trial happening this week. She is accused of orchestrating a breach to prove election theft. Peters has pleaded not guilty, claiming she is a victim of lawfare.

The Colorado Secretary of State’s office has refuted her claims summarized in three reports Peters has published, called the “Mesa Reports.” State prosecutors allege that Peters enlisted software engineer Gerald “Jerry” Wood for IT contract work. Wood passed a background check, received his security badge, and returned it the same day. However, prosecutors claim his badge was used twice in May 2021 to access secure election facilities, capturing images of the election server’s hard drive before and after a “trusted build” update, which were then leaked online._
**[LISTEN HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**

**[Who is Harris’ VP candidate Tim Walz? A far Left radical, Trump campaign says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | NATIONAL | AUGUST 6**
****_Where does the selection of Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz as vice president place a possible Kamala Harris-Walz presidential administration on the political spectrum?_
**_[Sold out: Trump will visit Aspen for fundraiser and you most likely can’t get a ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 5** __
_The hardest ticket to get in Colorado this week — and the most expensive — will be a seat to be in attendance when former President Donald Trump returns to Colorado._

| | | | | Peter -- It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan. I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down. Because there is just too much at stake: Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class. Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers. Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues. And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history. [So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general election. Will you split a donation of $10 between Blue Amp Action and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor? ** **](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te4912557-8b9d-4e7f-a9c3-88bd7628d405/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| In short: the real race begins now, Peter. We’re up against Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, a man who has shown that he’ll say or do anything to get elected. He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide, but threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician, Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as 2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate. It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself. I will be working to make sure every Michigan voter understands just how bad Mike Rogers would be for Michiganders if elected to the Senate, but we need resources to start immediately holding him accountable to his record. [Will you become a General Election Founding Donor today and chip in $10 to Blue Amp Action and my campaign? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5d379898-a51c-4126-aaa5-8d09a464bda4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | Dear Peter, The major social problems of the United States--deteriorating education, lawlessness and crime, homelessness, the collapse of family values, the crisis in medical care--all have one thing in common. They have all been produced by the well-intended actions of the government.

And yet, for some reason, more and more Americans look to government as the solution to their problems.

Hi Peter, My name is Andrea Morse, and I’m a lifelong Democrat running for Congress in NY-11 to defeat Trump’s favorite Republican, Rep. Nicole Malliotakis. I’m also a 3rd generation Staten Islander, a mom, a small business owner, a runner, a history buff, and a fighter for the people. As the granddaughter of a dedicated Union Machinist and the wife of a Union Carpenter, I understand the values of hard work and solidarity. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90433463/490500980/217408241?refcode=24_ws1_img1&ms=24_ws1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTIwMTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGM5ZDYxMTUtODk1NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QnGQYgUlgC8WhAq83LE6Bo8fHSxwnE6F8RhWI9_c1pw=) **The people of Staten Island and Southern Brooklyn deserve a leader who isn’t afraid to stand up for what’s right.** As your Representative, I’ll work to be a voice for working class people, because I know that a pathway to the middle class is possible through union labor. I’m prepared to be a relentless advocate for working people and families. Unlike Rep. Malliotakis, I’ll actually focus on building a better future for the next generation. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90433465/490500981/217408241?refcode=24_ws1_img2&ms=24_ws1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTIwMTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGM5ZDYxMTUtODk1NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QnGQYgUlgC8WhAq83LE6Bo8fHSxwnE6F8RhWI9_c1pw=) _**In order to take back the House of Representatives, we need to do everything we can to flip seats, including many here in New York. So much is on the line in this election, including women’s rights, fighting for affordable healthcare, and protecting Democracy. I’m ready to bring back civility and bipartisanship to Congress and deliver for NY-11’s hard-working families.**_ I know we have a tough road ahead of us, and we won’t be able to flip this seat without your help. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1745%2E135344%2EEQVYP8)

Friend,
While my team and I have been reaching out all week about the August 6th primary election and how big of a moment this is for our race, I wanted to take a moment to explain to you how our campaign specifically changes now that we’re in the general election.
Since we launched in February 2023, we have been running a strategic and thoughtful campaign that builds towards a three month stretch -- from August 7th until November 5th.
Everything that we have done up until now has been about methodically building a runway: traveling across the state to meet voters, airing TV and digital ads, recruiting volunteers to do that crucial direct voter contact, and raising money to fund all of that.
It’s August 8. The runway is built. Now we have to fly the plane.
As a part of our methodical planning over the last 18 months, we have built a budget that reflects what we believe to be a winning campaign in the swingiest of swing states. Within that budget, we have built out projections -- educated estimates about how much money we need and expect to raise for each month, week, and even day of the general election.
Here is where we stand on that right now: Every dollar that we have raised so far has been allocated. But so has the money we haven’t raised yet.
That means that anytime we dip below our weekly and monthly projections, we have to make difficult decisions. It would mean cutting crucial expenditures, like TV ads and voter contact operations. The bottom line is that every dollar we do not raise results in us reaching fewer voters.
With everything going on in politics right now, this is not just about our race for the U.S. Senate -- although I’m confident we can win if we have the resources. It’s also about what our performance means for the rest of the ticket.
So for every voter that our campaign does not reach, there is one fewer touch point for Democrats at large. After the presidential election at the top of the ticket, I am next to the top of the ticket and I take that responsibility to other candidates on the ballot very seriously. Our gain is their gain, and our loss is their loss.
So that is where we stand as of today, August 8. We have done everything that we can to prepare for this moment, but preparation alone will not win us this election. We will win on the strength of our operation over the final 89 days.
[**That is why I am asking you today: will you chip in $3 directly to my campaign today to help power us through this final sprint and keep Michigan blue? This would be an incredibly important moment for your support.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240808-1-900&t=2&akid=1745%2E135344%2EEQVYP8)

clean_body: Friend, While my team and I have been reaching out all week about the August 6th primary election and how big of a moment this is for our race, I wanted to take a moment to explain to you how our campaign specifically changes now that we’re in the general election. Since we launched in February 2023, we have been running a strategic and thoughtful campaign that builds towards a three month stretch -- from August 7th until November 5th. Everything that we have done up until now has been about methodically building a runway: traveling across the state to meet voters, airing TV and digital ads, recruiting volunteers to do that crucial direct voter contact, and raising money to fund all of that. It’s August 8. The runway is built. Now we have to fly the plane. As a part of our methodical planning over the last 18 months, we have built a budget that reflects what we believe to be a winning campaign in the swingiest of swing states. Within that budget, we have built out projections -- educated estimates about how much money we need and expect to raise for each month, week, and even day of the general election. Here is where we stand on that right now: Every dollar that we have raised so far has been allocated. But so has the money we haven’t raised yet. That means that anytime we dip below our weekly and monthly projections, we have to make difficult decisions. It would mean cutting crucial expenditures, like TV ads and voter contact operations. The bottom line is that every dollar we do not raise results in us reaching fewer voters. With everything going on in politics right now, this is not just about our race for the U.S. Senate -- although I’m confident we can win if we have the resources. It’s also about what our performance means for the rest of the ticket. So for every voter that our campaign does not reach, there is one fewer touch point for Democrats at large. After the presidential election at the top of the ticket, I am next to the top of the ticket and I take that responsibility to other candidates on the ballot very seriously. Our gain is their gain, and our loss is their loss. So that is where we stand as of today, August 8. We have done everything that we can to prepare for this moment, but preparation alone will not win us this election. We will win on the strength of our operation over the final 89 days. This is a long email, but as a part of this movement and a supporter of this campaign, I wanted to send it to you this morning for a couple of very important reasons. I hope you'll read it.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1295%2E791427%2Eg3f-qH)

Hey team, it's Joelle — Ilhan's campaign manager.
I'm also a high school social studies teacher here in Minneapolis, a proud member of MFT Local 59, and an organizer in my community who has known Ilhan for nearly 10 years, even before she became a leading voice for our movement in Congress.
This is a long email, but as a part of this team and a supporter of our campaign, I wanted to send it to you this morning for a couple of very important reasons. I hope you'll read it.
As we've seen in primaries across the country this cycle, outside money is getting a bit cocky about beating progressives. After making NY-16 the most expensive House primary in history to defeat Jamaal Bowman back in June, they then turned their attention to Cori Bush in Missouri, spending $13.5 million on vicious, racist attack ads to try and defeat her.
On Tuesday night, the super PACs and their billionaire donors got their wish. Cori lost her primary, and with it the working class of our country lost one of its fiercest, most committed allies in Congress.
As one of the few remaining progressive incumbents yet to have their primary this cycle, the focus could still shift to Ilhan over the course of the next few days. It's likely the outside spenders will dump money into Minnesota's 5th district in an attempt to smear Ilhan, using all the vile tactics we've seen them run with before.
So yes. At the end of this email, **[I'll be asking for your support to fight back against them.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug24.QjfTG2&refcode=em240808-1&t=2&akid=1295%2E791427%2Eg3f-qH)** But before I do, and before the super PAC cash starts flowing, I wanted to share a bit about Congresswoman Ilhan Omar from my own personal experience.
**The Ilhan I know is a policy expert.**
Before she ever ran for office, Ilhan was a Senior Policy Aide. As a state legislator, she was the chief author for 38 bills in her first session. And in Congress, she introduced the Zero Waste Act, the Homes for All Act, and the Universal School Meals Act.
**The Ilhan I know is an organizer.**
Anyone who knows Ilhan has heard her say, _"You get what you organize for."_ And she does. She knocks doors, visits local businesses, meets with grassroots leaders, tours schools, hosts round tables, walks picket lines — the girl is everywhere!
**The Ilhan I know is approachable.**
Last year, I had the pleasure of giving her a tour of my school. Our first stop was meeting with Muslim student leaders. She took the time to connect with each student, one by one. They still talk about that day and how much it meant to them.**
**The Ilhan I know loves this community.**
Ilhan survived a war. She fled her home and built a new one here. She talks about how when she arrived here, Minnesotans took care of her. She constantly tells me about how humbled and honored she is to serve the community who welcomed her.
The other day, I was on the phone with a voter who plans to vote for our opponent, Don Samuels. I asked him what he liked about Don, and he couldn't give me a single reason.
What he could do, however, was rattle off the tired and typical anti-Ilhan talking points.
I said, "Well, I know Ilhan." And he listened.
Here's the reality, folks. So much of what people think they know about Ilhan is tainted and distorted by the many anti-immigrant and anti-Muslim messages out there. It's not their fault — the messages are everywhere! It's really hard not to internalize them.
It's those biases that the outside money are going to try and lean on in the next five days. And it's likely that they're going to spend millions of dollars to do it.
The Ilhan I know works tirelessly to give back to the community that welcomed her as a refugee. The Ilhan I know introduces sweeping progressive legislation. The Ilhan I know has delivered. The Ilhan I know is the real Ilhan — not the one you see in the cheap, grainy attack ads.
So, long story short — there's a lot of nasty stuff out there. And it might make it hard to know the real Ilhan.
But I do know her. I have for nearly a decade. And I can tell you this — there's no one better to represent our movement in Congress.
**[So please. Can you make a contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — to help Ilhan and our progressive movement fight back against the right-wing super PACs and their billionaire donors? With just 5 days to go in this race, anything you can chip in will play a major part in sending Ilhan back to Congress.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug24.QjfTG2&refcode=em240808-1&t=3&akid=1295%2E791427%2Eg3f-qH)**

body:
Another dangerous lie.
Have you heard the latest pathetic nonsense from Mike Lawler, team? **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90438028/490512866/-150841850?refcode=em24_240808_lawlvid_fnd_gq_act___mj_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240808_lawlvid_fnd_gq_act___mj_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=5d2f201b-8d55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDJmMjAxYi04ZDU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DehAly_yX7YH_iz5xt6iqS3GpXwJkBTwoKWm9W379Ts=)** Lawler recently campaigned for Donald Trump and JD Vance, and gave remarks in which he claimed that Democrats “hate this country.” He didn’t realize he was being recorded, so he showed his true colors.

The other crazy thing he said was that Donald Trump “loves this country.” The same Donald Trump who incited a deadly insurrection trying to overturn the last presidential election. The same Trump who says he wants to “terminate” the Constitution and pardon the insurrectionists who attacked law enforcement officers on January 6th. **The same convicted felon Mike Lawler supports for President of the United States.**

Let me be clear: there is only one party that is actually fighting for the American people and the issues that matter most to them—**Democrats.** Our record speaks for itself:

I was proud to be part of the most productive Congress in modern history. ---
Friend: You and I both know that Rick Scott has spent his time as senator doing more harm than good, pushing forward a dangerous agenda that has put the lives of millions at risk. **Now, Floridians have had enough — and that's why we're saying:_Ya no más_. **
We've had enough of his lies, promising to defend IVF after voting against both IVF and birth control protections. **_Ya no más_**.

We’ve had enough of his plan to raise taxes on the middle class and cut them for the wealthy. **_Ya no más._**

We’ve had enough of his radical schemes to roll back reproductive rights and end vital programs like Social Security and Medicare. **_Ya no más._**

We’ve had enough of him throwing everything aside to be Donald Trump’s lap dog, and back the Trump-Vance campaign. _**Ya no****más**_.
