subject: What I learned from an OnlyFans star and Missouri's most famous teacher (Part 1)
body:
Listen to my conversation with Brianna Coppage, who lost her job at St. Clair High School. Her story is illustrative of just how brutally difficult it is for teachers to make ends meet.

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.pOJcX_Q4Ps2XFj5GoiTB4ddBB6J1RKKAR_xgB9rf2BI?) for more
---
Politics is full of universal truths, axioms, and unquestioned orthodoxy. We're here to take a closer look at some of that.
Welcome to **Not Quite Right ...** Where we break down unchallenged assumptions.
* * *
# [What I learned from an OnlyFans star and Missouri's most famous teacher (Part 1)](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=146998360&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2OTk4MzYwLCJpYXQiOjE3MjMxMjUzMTgsImV4cCI6MTcyNTcxNzMxOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.HogSfmMjGS_oBJpjoUZJoc97ZO65qbv4oQSbPVbjhvU)
### Listen to my conversation with Brianna Coppage, who lost her job at St. Clair High School. Her story is illustrative of how brutally difficult it is for teachers to make ends meet.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Aug 8
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
---
| | | [](https://substack..AHCpd_ot11Q-gQ48L1jQTWaA7-7fbKE7KdG0yc7T3Ek?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bensamuels/p/what-i-learned-from-an-onlyfans-star?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store)
---
When Missouri has been in the national news lately, it hasn't been for anything good. When Missouri legislators [tried to ban child marriage, the Senate said no](https://substack.com/redirect/2a754a63-9172-4afe-bbd7-15268bb5f0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). One Republican gubernatorial candidate was an [honorary member of the Klan](https://substack.com/redirect/63785b74-fffa-4a37-95fd-2a27864519e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); another Republican statewide candidate [thinks that Purina, the dog food company, is too gay](https://substack.com/redirect/b2fcba41-d64a-4e30-8e03-3f061e3d8bb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).1 The Legislature decided that, yes, 2023 was a [good time to tighten its dress code for women](https://substack.com/redirect/c0d31c18-3a5a-4647-80e5-ca50443082a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There are plenty of other examples. But late last year, one Missouri story made bigger news than just about any other: in the small town of [Saint Clair](https://substack.com/redirect/aab21948-69eb-4a5c-af08-defe0fbb5574?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), about an hour outside of St. Louis, two teachers--Brianna Coppage and Megan Gaither--lost their jobs2 because they were filming OnlyFans3 videos.
A few weeks ago, I got lunch with Brianna. I spoke with her because her story--one that involves [having been exposed as an OnlyFans content creator](https://substack.com/redirect/c758f239-3458-4344-9273-d61fd133362d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before [losing her job](https://substack.com/redirect/3ee50628-ab6a-4b5b-966e-a22de7037fec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at [St. Clair High School](https://substack.com/redirect/31c3d115-b5da-45c7-bba1-3958ebde47c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--has given her an [enormous](https://substack.com/redirect/9126424f-2228-497c-b232-28880a04c11c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [national](https://substack.com/redirect/29d10c24-35fb-4a0b-9306-523b9c4571b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [platform](https://substack.com/redirect/05d8039e-a174-4bb8-a17a-e1e47edd45b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/3982a769-5c05-465f-b194-1fb70b12662e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The _Daily Mail_ and the _New York Post_ have covered this story exactly the way you'd expect: a focus on the salacious details, on the culture wars that plague American education, or on the money that Brianna and Megan are now making,4 for instance.
**But at its core, this is a story about teacher pay.**
In the last year of available data, [Coppage made $42,000](https://substack.com/redirect/db04a217-fca4-4516-9789-0ce6af997ac0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Gaither made $48,000](https://substack.com/redirect/d3c664e7-8dc2-4cb4-a15b-bb9c0210085e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).5 Americans overwhelmingly agree that [teachers should be making more money](https://substack.com/redirect/48bc6f82-f785-492f-94d0-fc0e243352b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But here is what's **Not Quite Right ...** Even low pay doesn't tell the full story.
Teachers are required to go to college, which for most of them means taking on (and then paying off) debt. Many are working second jobs. Most work long hours after school. And all of this is happening as faith in [American education is at all-time lows](https://substack.com/redirect/b9693585-8071-4076-9873-d53c339283a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
It's no wonder that [fewer and fewer Americans want to become teachers](https://substack.com/redirect/f58d2af2-2283-460e-9e6d-158065beb8e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### Let's break down teacher pay
Below, listen to Brianna talk about her decision to join OnlyFans, and why she opted for that as opposed to another more traditional job--waitressing, for example.
[Listen now * 3:23](https://substack.com/redirect/75dcc734-83d3-4dc9-a965-246fa9e9201c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
It's worth breaking this down in a bit more detail. Brianna, according to Missouri public records, made $42,261 per year, which included a pittance of additional money for leading the cheer team.
But this doesn't tell the full story.6
* Making $42,261, you'll pay [roughly $3,189 in federal income taxes](https://substack.com/redirect/c14856bc-88db-492c-b835-90f15b76bbb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [$1,066 in state income taxes](https://substack.com/redirect/c89f1b5b-323e-45e5-9e81-70a9aa2bf194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That leaves $38,006.
* Brianna has a four-year college degree, a degree she is _[required](https://substack.com/redirect/7b985353-10fd-4228-bcc7-b558a7f4b3d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ to have to teach in Missouri](https://substack.com/redirect/7b985353-10fd-4228-bcc7-b558a7f4b3d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and a master's degree in education. She incurred $60,000 in student debt to get those degrees. If you're paying down those loans over 10 years, that's [roughly $8,000 per year](https://substack.com/redirect/52d80f0f-128a-4b84-b845-e8fed1a71daa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That leaves roughly $30,000.
* She mentioned a pain point I hadn't been aware of: according to the [handbook for the Public Education Employee Retirement System of Missouri](https://substack.com/redirect/2b0db3fc-bbd4-457c-ac95-632974d62856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (PEERS), employees are required to contribute 6.86% of their income to the pension, and that's calculated off of salary _and_ benefits like health insurance. I'll estimate $3,000 since I don't have good data on benefits.

**That leaves roughly $27,000 in take-home pay for someone with a master 's degree.** And this is before accounting for rent (roughly [$1,000 per month in Saint Clair](https://substack.com/redirect/5f23f7a6-a597-4f7c-ac82-eba930a72491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and childcare--Brianna worked full-time and has a child, so that's obviously a consideration too (more below on that).7
For context, the [median wage in Missouri is $57,580](https://substack.com/redirect/6ad09ea1-1707-437f-a808-875552ee8603?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the [median wage for someone with a master's degree in Missouri is $90,324](https://substack.com/redirect/c32e3b08-3a6a-494f-9397-1e152bfb2380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Assuming the same levels of student debt, that means that the median person with a master's degree in Missouri has a take-home, after-debt pay of roughly $67,000--2.5× higher than Brianna.8
This problem is only getting worse, by the way. [Teacher salaries over the past 25 years have increased appreciably less](https://substack.com/redirect/29911a48-40aa-4440-8b64-32e2a52098a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than wages for other college graduates. [By one measure](https://substack.com/redirect/628c87c1-8d49-48c0-9ccc-d9b60e6f7959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "the average salary of teachers has actually _declined_ by an estimated 6.4 percent, or $3,644, over the past decade."
### Most teachers work second jobs (although those second jobs usually aren't worldwide news)
OnlyFans aside, it's worth noting how many teachers hold second jobs. A Pew survey in 2019 found that [16% of teachers hold second jobs during the school year](https://substack.com/redirect/10902c9d-da13-4c39-894f-b62e5beaaa88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),9 and the National Center for Education Statistics reports that [58% of all public school teachers earn income from sources](https://substack.com/redirect/c6882236-6ccf-4dc2-9997-76674283911b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) other than their base teaching salary, which generally means work during the summer.
Most, of course, are not producing pornography. I couldn't find any good data on what second jobs and summer jobs for teachers are most common, but I imagine a lot of teachers are doing something similar to what [Stacey Robinson](https://substack.com/redirect/aae84e6b-e1fe-49db-b509-0162de9515ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a teacher in [Cooter, Missouri](https://substack.com/redirect/3c96ae98-b836-44d9-9247-d71db788f98b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),10 said she was doing in a 2022 interview:
> On top of teaching third and fourth graders full time, Robinson also works 10 hours per week as a school custodian, which brings in about $600 extra per month. She earns $25 for every school sporting event she manages, too, taking money at the door and operating the concession stand during three or four ball games a week. She cares for elderly patients, including her father, at an independent living company that pays her about $650 per month. She also paints houses for around $20 an hour.
### Working other jobs means finding childcare, which is prohibitively expensive--if it's available at all
All of this requires that you're _able_ to work after regular hours or during the summer, and for anyone with children, that means adequate access to childcare. But across America, there is not anything close to adequate access, [especially in rural areas](https://substack.com/redirect/86485dca-5061-4d8a-b7da-52f7bd45f89c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). According to the Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services, [59% of rural communities do not have enough childcare](https://substack.com/redirect/58bc2a89-b1f9-49c1-a361-ac96f6f933ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The [cost of childcare has meaningfully outpaced inflation](https://substack.com/redirect/3c5514b4-3b5d-4962-8294-b16cc2f6329a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the last 35 years, right at the same time that the opposite is happening with teacher salaries. Today, families in Missouri with young children are spending close to [$10,000 per year](https://substack.com/redirect/ec962079-6102-439b-a3a2-7fa2077e6e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--more, if you have an infant.11
Here's the other problem: the [vast majority of childcare facilities are not open on nights or weekends](https://substack.com/redirect/d2ec7f72-ccd1-4b5b-a830-483cb33b1921?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So even if you could afford to pay for childcare, somehow, and even if you found a job you would want to work after school, it's _still_ not a viable option.
### The significant challenges of rural schools
Obviously, I wish the solution here were simply to pay teachers more. But it's not like Missouri schools are swimming money; in fact, across Missouri, [30% of districts have moved to four-day school weeks](https://substack.com/redirect/7723d1f2-009c-40e6-957d-bb6e31a92e68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is an enormous problem in its own right. Listen to Brianna talk about broken and inadequate school infrastructure:
[Listen now * 0:48](https://substack.com/redirect/75dcc734-83d3-4dc9-a965-246fa9e9201c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Or that her at-school meal options were undersized, overpriced, and--I mean this literally--moldy:
[Listen now * 0:51](https://substack.com/redirect/75dcc734-83d3-4dc9-a965-246fa9e9201c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Between demographic shifts away from rural areas and low pay, recruiting teachers in rural areas is difficult enough as is. Surely we can find ways to serve teachers (and students) food that isn't moldy.
### It's really hard for rural teachers to make ends meet
Brianna mentioned to me that far more teachers than anyone realizes are filming videos on OnlyFans. And after speaking with her, I get it. I get why so many teachers head down that path, if it's an option for them.
Teaching is hard and underpaid. Working ancillary jobs at school--coaching, for instance--isn't a meaningful additional source of income, especially given the additional hours it entails. Finding other more conventional work (as a waiter, for instance) is difficult, if it's even an option at all with childcare constraints.
What good options do you have if you're behind on rent? Or if you're struggling to make student loan payments?
I generally have no problem with this sort of elective, consensual sex work, but **teachers shouldn 't have to look to OnlyFans to make ends meet**.
I can't believe I'm even writing that; what a sad commentary on the state of education in America, and how we treat our teachers.
Brianna is happy with the income and stability, but she said that she doesn't want to do this for more than another two years or so. And I get that too--yes, the pay is good, and yes, there's good flexibility in how, when, and what kind of work you do. But I can imagine how hard it is to do this kind of work, and to have been exposed in such a public way. And I'm sure it is difficult in all sorts of ways that I cannot imagine or understand.
### How do we fix this?
While I believe that paying teachers more is important, it's probably not realistic in a lot of the country.
In Part 2, I'll discuss how licensure is crippling our ability to recruit teachers (and professionals in other jobs). I'll write more about rural labor shortages in education. I'll write about what else we can be doing. And I'll cover what we can learn from Utah--a state that has some of the lowest per-student spending but some of the best outcomes and highest educational attainment.
More to come.
### Finally, a note for the swingers of St. Louis
I'll end on a more fun note. Take a listen.
[Listen now * 0:51](https://substack.com/redirect/75dcc734-83d3-4dc9-a965-246fa9e9201c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
I'm sharing for the funny observation, but in all seriousness, the message here from Brianna is a good one. A little more empathy and understanding would go a long way--in politics and in the world--right now.
_**Feel free to share this post with someone who will enjoy it.** (If you're reading this email because someone sent it to you, [please consider subscribing](https://substack.com/redirect/3982a769-5c05-465f-b194-1fb70b12662e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)_
[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/3982a769-5c05-465f-b194-1fb70b12662e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
1
[Valentina Gomez](https://substack.com/redirect/f242320e-7034-4752-baef-cc8ece2ca9f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who's clearly a few donuts short of a dozen, may not understand the difference between "dog grooming" and the grooming that she seems to think is turning her pets gay. (Fortunately, both Gomez and McClanahan lost their primaries.)
2
I won't get into the HR details of whether they were fired, whether they resigned, whether they were asked to resign, etc. It's not really salient to what I'm writing about. What's very clear is that it's untenable to be known OnlyFans content creators and teach, and both are no longer teachers.
3
If you aren't familiar with OnlyFans, here's the Wikipedia description: "OnlyFans is an internet content subscription service...used primarily by sex workers who produce pornography, but it also hosts the work of other content creators, such as physical fitness experts and musicians." Think of it as [Patreon](https://substack.com/redirect/6522287d-7828-4044-88e5-74cc5e4233a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) meets pornography.
4
Brianna, at one point, [made $1 million over six months](https://substack.com/redirect/34bc3a49-5af1-4e50-99dd-03039af5d7e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), enough to have started buying investment properties for rental income. Megan was, before losing her job, [making $3,000-$5,000 per month](https://substack.com/redirect/1c7163b3-b38b-41e9-bff2-efbadd8a0bb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) via OnlyFans. I imagine she's making a lot more these days.
5
I'm not revealing any secret information here. This is all publicly disclosed under Missouri's [Sunshine Law](https://substack.com/redirect/dbb33a34-263a-4191-bbb5-57443db7e4f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and readily available in a database that the _[St. Louis Post-Dispatch](https://substack.com/redirect/5b488623-b916-4281-be5c-886d8133f57d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ makes available](https://substack.com/redirect/5b488623-b916-4281-be5c-886d8133f57d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
6
This is all very back-of-the-envelope math. It's not meant to be perfectly accurate, but it should paint a picture of what we're looking at here.
7
If you assume $12,000 per year in rent and $10,000 per year in childcare, you have $5,000 left to feed a family, get around, and live a life.
8
Of course, because of school holidays, teachers work fewer days than most workers (though they work longer hours on the days that they work). But finding seasonal temp work during the summer isn't always easy, especially jobs that are suited for someone who has a master's degree.
9
For a variety of reasons, I wouldn't be surprised if the real number is actually higher than that. There's an incentive not to tell your employer that you're working another job, and that goes beyond just teaching. And some of this data is a few years old, and the cost-of-living challenges have only gotten more acute since then.
10
I know I'm writing a post about teachers who do OnlyFans, I know there's a joke in here about a town named Cooter, let's all just move on.
11
I'll note that the data is inconsistent on this point--I've seen estimates closer to $5,000 and others closer to $20,000, but most of the robust analyses seem to center around that $10,000 figure. I think the inconsistency exists for a few different reasons: there may be some technical differences in what constitutes childcare, some data is out of date, costs vary wildly by geography, etc. But what is clear: it's expensive, often prohibitively so.

body:
Useful links and resources from the Office of Delegate Briana Sewell | | |
---
# **INFORMATION ON TROPICAL STORM DEBBY**

---
| | Dear Neighbors, Over the next 36 hours, residents of the 25th District and beyond will experience heavy rain, high wind gusts, and potential flooding as Tropical Storm Debby is expected to travel up the East Coast. I urge each of you to take precautions at home and when traveling and make sure you are prepared for the storm. **Please view the image below for emergency resources compiled by my office.**
---
| |
---
| | At the request of the [**Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT)**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90440914/490522918/565034739?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWM5NTk1Yy05MDU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pU0J2_f52w_JZkXOMJtdTcWjoQrIYl9O1R7knGcFG8E=&emci=df08ab96-8b55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=eec9595c-9055-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=21796801)**,** all motorists are asked to limit travel based upon evolving road conditions. The peak impact of Tropical Storm Debby is anticipated to be felt between this afternoon, August 8th, and tomorrow evening, August 9th. Given the high potential for localized flooding and road hazard resulting from the storm, VDOT crews stand ready and prepared to respond. Please pay close attention to local weather reports and announcements for the latest information regarding storm and road conditions throughout the region.
---
[**Dominion Energy**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90440915/490522919/-1300593375?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWM5NTk1Yy05MDU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pU0J2_f52w_JZkXOMJtdTcWjoQrIYl9O1R7knGcFG8E=&emci=df08ab96-8b55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=eec9595c-9055-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=21796801) serves as the primary energy source for businesses and residents located within the 25th District. As previously noted, Tropical Storm Debby is expected to continue north into the Commonwealth of Virginia in the coming hours. Due to anticipated high winds and severe thunderstorms, the potential for flooding, ground saturation, and falling trees could lead to multi-day outages. My office has received notice that Dominion Energy has crews stationed ready to assist with power restoration as safely and quickly as possible.
---
| | [**Do you have an emergency kit together?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90440916/490522920/1867209643?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWM5NTk1Yy05MDU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pU0J2_f52w_JZkXOMJtdTcWjoQrIYl9O1R7knGcFG8E=&emci=df08ab96-8b55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=eec9595c-9055-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=21796801) It is a good idea to stock up on food, water, and emergency supplies. Consider stocking up on bottled water and non-perishable food available, as well as emergency supplies like flashlights, batteries, first aid kits, and medications. Make sure to fully charge your phone, computer, and other electronic devices before the storm arrives. You might also want to consider buying portable batteries to keep your devices powered for longer.

I urge each of you to take precautions at home and when traveling and make sure you are prepared for the storm. Please view the image below for emergency resources compiled by my office. | | | | At the request of the , all motorists are asked to limit travel based upon evolving road conditions. The peak impact of Tropical Storm Debby is anticipated to be felt between this afternoon, August 8th, and tomorrow evening, August 9th. Given the high potential for localized flooding and road hazard resulting from the storm, VDOT crews stand ready and prepared to respond. Please pay close attention to local weather reports and announcements for the latest information regarding storm and road conditions throughout the region. serves as the primary energy source for businesses and residents located within the 25th District. As previously noted, Tropical Storm Debby is expected to continue north into the Commonwealth of Virginia in the coming hours. Due to anticipated high winds and severe thunderstorms, the potential for flooding, ground saturation, and falling trees could lead to multi-day outages. My office has received notice that Dominion Energy has crews stationed ready to assist with power restoration as safely and quickly as possible. | | It is a good idea to stock up on food, water, and emergency supplies. Consider stocking up on bottled water and non-perishable food available, as well as emergency supplies like flashlights, batteries, first aid kits, and medications. Make sure to fully charge your phone, computer, and other electronic devices before the storm arrives. You might also want to consider buying portable batteries to keep your devices powered for longer. Dear Fellow American,

No one is fighting harder to keep our elections honest than your Judicial Watch!

Our "warnings" and lawsuits get real results....and [**that's why I hope you can help us with a tax-deductible gift today.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69531&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

| Dear Fellow American,

A warning (technically, a "notice letter") is what Judicial Watch sent to the Oregon Secretary of State last week, warning the State of Oregon of their evident violations of the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) requiring the removal of inactive voters from their voter rolls.
If Oregon fails to begin cleaning its voter rolls in a timely fashion, we will go to federal court and sue them!
Our warning to Oregon is based on our election law team's thorough review of federal and state election data. This is a detailed, demanding, "roll up your sleeves" process...a _process that no other group in the country undertakes_.
It is also expensive!
**[That's why I hope you will make a special contribution to Judicial Watch today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69531&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69531&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Dirty election rolls can mean dirty elections

...and with a presidential election less than four months away, it is vital that Oregon gets to work cleaning its voter registration rolls of ineligible voters to remove any cloud of doubt over the legitimacy of its balloting.

The corrupt Biden Justice Department should be pursuing this action in court, not Judicial Watch...but for years the Justice Department has failed to do its duty.

And that's why...[with the support you have given us in the past](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69531&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)...Judicial Watch has stepped into the breach, and already forced the removal of over 4.5 million ineligible voters from voter lists across the country...and that number is about to go up!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69531&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

When states won't clean their voter lists as the law requires and the Justice Department fails to take action, Judicial Watch goes into action.

We don't just _talk_ about honest elections...we _deliver_ real, tangible results.

And I don't believe there is anything more important in the fight to preserve our Republic than to preserve honest elections.

Thank you for your past support of Judicial Watch, and for our mission of upholding the rule of law.

[I hope you will help us again today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69531&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2). I promise you that every day, your Judicial Watch is fighting for you and honest government!

Thomas Fitton

clean_body: | | Peter, Allow me to do away with the typical politician fundraising email charade and be transparent with you: I just want your money. It's a terrible thing to ask. Why should I be entitled to money you've worked hard to earn? It's ridiculous that our system requires candidates to beg for money 24/7. Candidates should be talking to voters and hearing what their needs are, not selling themselves to the largest bidder. The one part of this campaign that I can’t stand is asking for money. I’m running to serve and support you, not the other way around. Sadly, raising money is a necessity in our current political system. In order to beat Max Miller and Donald Trump, we need to be able to buy ad time, send mailers, and spread word about our campaign. And that takes money. This is a very tight race, and we can’t afford to fall behind on fundraising. I'm sorry to have to ask this of you. But we need all the support we can get. Sincerely, Matt Diemer Democratic Candidate for Congress OH-7 | Diemer for Congress P.O. Box 40042 Bay Village, Ohio 44140 | | | Sent via . | | | Peter -

We only have 89 days until Election Day! That means we only have 89 days to raise money, knock doors, make phone calls, and convince the voters of Nevada’s 3rd congressional district to support our vision to close our borders, protect our communities, empower parents, and make life affordable again.

Last week, I spent time with **House Speaker Mike Johnson.** The Speaker made it clear that he and other Republican leaders in Washington consider **_our race one of the best opportunities in America_** to pick up a seat in the House of Representatives. It’s a seat we _must_ _win_ if we want to keep – and expand – GOP control of the House.

That’s why **House Republican Leadership** , including **Speaker Johnson** , **Majority Leader Steve Scalise** , **Majority Whip Tom Emmer** , **Republican Conference Chairwoman Elise Stefanik** , **National Republican Congressional Committee Chairman Richard Hudson** , and my longtime friend, **Republican Policy Committee Chairman Gary Palmer** , have endorsed me and are fully supporting me as we fight to win this CRUCIAL race.

Mark your calendar! We have several great events coming up, including our **Back to School Party in the Park** _this Saturday_ and a **cookie swap** _featuring my inspiring wife Sarah_ on Sunday! Check out the “Upcoming Events” section below for all the details.

Finally, every dollar is vital as we fight to send corrupt Susie Lee packing!

[**Donate here.**](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8a9b298755&e=fc26432468)

# **_Endorsement Alert!_**
Drew is proud to have earned the support of Speaker Mike Johnson!
---
| **“I'm proud to endorse Drew Johnson in Nevada's 3rd Congressional District. With Drew's background of more than two decades creating solutions to cut wasteful spending, lower prescription drug costs, and promote energy independence at several of America's leading free market think tanks, he's exactly the kind of policy leader we need in Washington.

Electing Drew Johnson is critical to keeping and expanding our House majority, and I hope you'll join me in supporting him.”**
---
|
---
|
---
|
# _Upcoming Events_
---
|
### August 10 | 11 AM - 1 PM
---
| Bring your kids to the Back to School Party in the Park at Bruce Trent Park! There will be **refreshments, food trucks, bounce houses, and plenty of free fun**! Drew is co-hosting the event with two other amazing candidates and wonderful people, **Jill Douglass** , candidate for State Senate District 6, and **Brandon Davis** , candidate for State Assembly District 34.
---
|
---
|
###
August 11 | 2 PM - 3:30 PM
---
| Join **Siena Patriots** for a **cookie swap and meet-and-greet with Sarah Johnson**. Not only is Sarah Drew’s charming better half, she is also our state’s leading voice for entrepreneurs as the Director of the Nevada Office of Small Business Advocacy under our tireless **Lieutenant Governor Stavros Anthony.** Make sure to RSVP to Kerry Ferguson at the email or phone number below.
---
|
---
|
###
August 16 | 6 - 7:30 PM
---
| Our dedicated supporters **Mason and Eimy Martinez** are hosting a fun and informal evening with Sarah Johnson.

The event is aimed at women who want to learn more about the political landscape, find out about volunteer opportunities, and hear what it’s really like behind-the-scenes of a campaign.

**[Email Carolina to RSVP by August 9th.](mailto:carolina@drewfornevada.com?subject=RSVP%20for%20Aug%2016%20event) **
---
|
---
|
###
August 17 | 10 AM
---
| Join Drew and other outstanding candidates at **Turning Point Actions' Super Chase** Nevada rally!

Drew and other leaders will discuss how to get out the vote and collect ballots so great Republican candidates can win up and down the ballot this November.

[**RSVP here.**](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=9bf8490f86&e=fc26432468)

|
# **_In the Media_**
---
| Sam Shad [interviewed Drew on Nevada Newsmakers](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=f01c22427f&e=fc26432468) to discuss his plans for improving the lives of voters in Nevada’s 3rd congressional district.

---

---

| Drew joined [**AM670’s Live and Local with guest host Pat Casale**](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=e35a2b3407&e=fc26432468) to talk about the issues Southern Nevadans are most concerned about and how to make sure great candidates win this November.
---
|
---
|
# _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 4_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

**1. Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=7190780ad0&e=fc26432468)**.

**2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew**: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email [linnea@drewfornevada.com](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!).

**3. Volunteer for the Campaign:** #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit** **[THIS](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ff689e2452&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

**4. Put up a Yard Sign:** One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign. Email your name and address to Carolina@DrewforNevada.com and we'll ship one at **NO COST** to you!

Dear Friend,

I'm grateful to connect with you today and share an opportunity to impact the lives of our courageous missionaries serving in remote and challenging regions around the world.

In the farthest corners of the globe, these dedicated men, women, and families are sacrificing their comfort, security, and personal aspirations to bring the hope and transformative message of salvation to those who have never heard it before. With unwavering faith, they face incredible trials, enduring isolation, and even risking their safety to fulfill the calling placed upon their lives.

Yet, even people with the strongest commitment to their missionary calling can sometimes grow weary and feel discouraged. **That's where you come in.** I firmly believe that God can use your words of encouragement to reassure our missionaries that He is with them, strengthening them to press on.

Would you take a moment to write a note of encouragement to one of our missionaries serving in the field? Your notes of encouragement can be an instrument of hope God uses to remind them that they are not alone as they shine the light of the gospel in the darkest corners of the world. [
Will you help encourage a missionary serving in the field? Your message can be a lifeline, assuring them that their sacrifices are seen and deeply appreciated. ](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=7b408db095834e0f8f9d17a509d8d344&_e=ZvgRb-UW0WACjBy3_r0nRXcHgJlpKTX-1tA0SswglE54EaIJei0EGKw5z6spdF3LbTuvF1gU-BEJjPNyic9Id2HOHS6bvERFVM2iA0xwvAZ0yLy9WtAlRzw2kXeEcuBQa_GjdjvyoiU0VTWhI7cpge87DCA0NcUi-U1FUo-cUSKSMAgZ5w8waWLaGM2XyOyFtFtPnRTu0eqkA0-pb7MzJ7H3e_f-uRBI4KQPjQQxg13v1mVoTiv24Xz2h4d2jb_ic26l9C1WsN2gXsUQrArBIK0eGeu-hi2312VfKJEANG2NhWOuyCX4k48gJPv1-ZMK1MoweiTgSr7LtH05uYCbbN8lMBlMPQE-0-3CACyiRaWKA0lhpg_-z334-WVdHHFI) **To send your note of encouragement, I invite you to fill out the secure form in this link:**

[https://welcome.imb.org/note_of_encouragement_lp.html](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=7b408db095834e0f8f9d17a509d8d344&_e=ZvgRb-UW0WACjBy3_r0nRXcHgJlpKTX-1tA0SswglE54EaIJei0EGKw5z6spdF3LbTuvF1gU-BEJjPNyic9Id2HOHS6bvERFVM2iA0xwvAZ0yLy9WtAlRzw2kXeEcuBQa_GjdjvyoiU0VTWhI7cpge87DCA0NcUi-U1FUo-cUSKSMAgZ5w8waWLaGM2XyOyFtFtPnRTu0eqkA0-pb7MzJ2uuW4cREX3O3npu1qt7DinQmLYMp4owQAnKjHSRO8bJAxAfthxBDvcTRKEfZ1Z9JB_Ri0tcC1Z-_9fwBLng7ZzT5R-iO_x9x0XxDehEnroUxF5z1g_N5-2uRd-cYa87c1SIe5EC5c0R1R5KEbfZwgT3jPji5A2zA0lgGjNRO14G)

Thank you for your commitment to the Great Commission. Your support and prayers are invaluable in reaching those who have yet to experience the life-changing power of the gospel.

We are deeply grateful for your partnership in advancing the Kingdom of God.

In Christ,

Emily Hall

IMB Prayer Office

#
Dear Friend and Supporter,

We are rounding the bend on the General Election in less than 90 days. At that time, early voting will have begun, and the General Election will be held on November 5, 2024. I thank you for your vote and support during my tenure and look forward to winning another term for West Virginia.

Because this election year is a Presidential Election year, voter turnout will be particularly important for many Republican candidates. When President Biden stepped down from his campaign for a second term, it meant turnout from both parties will be heavy. I am in an advantageous position to win re-election in November. I have a Democrat challenger, so we hope all my supporters will vote and encourage others to do so as well. I have counted on you in the past and I am sure you will continue to support me in November.

My team has had many successes over the past two terms. The department is well-run and has accomplished many meaningful successes with a budget much the same as 2008. We approached the job with an eye on prudent fiscal decisions and have contributed to West Virginia’s record high budget surpluses. My team and I keep eyes on everything and leave nothing to chance, resulting in staying on the right track.

I am campaigning by crisscrossing the state to connect with as many voters as possible. In addition, I continue to perform the duties you have elected me to do. I hope you will stay with me and contribute to my re-election campaign to keep the momentum going. Your support now could make a wonderful difference in November!

name: Mark Kelly
subject: A desperate, scared man
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
It is up to us to do everything we can to move the needle in the right direction and make sure that people like Trump, like JD Vance, like Kari Lake here in Arizona are defeated — once and for all. We need to organize, we need to volunteer, we need to talk to our friends and family. We can’t waste a single day, a single moment, between now and election day. The stakes are too high, especially in a must-win state like Arizona.
#

You read that right.
Donald Trump is a desperate, scared man.
But he is a desperate, scared man with about a 50/50 chance of becoming the next President of the United States.
It’s up to us to do everything we can to move the needle in the right direction and make sure that people like Trump, like JD Vance, like Kari Lake here in Arizona are defeated — once and for all. We need to organize, we need to volunteer, we need to talk to our friends and family. We can’t waste a single day, a single moment, between now and election day. The stakes are too high, especially in a must-win state like Arizona.
I am not done, and I’ll be hard at work making sure that we solidify the gains we have made here in Arizona over the next few months. I’m personally invested in building the infrastructure we need to win, and I’m supporting pro-democracy candidates up and down the ballot to do it.
But all of that is for nothing if I don’t have you behind me. Arizona isn’t just one of the most competitive states in the country — it’s one of the most expensive, too.
So, respectfully, I’m asking you to chip in.
[**Can you make a donation of $5 or $10 to support my work in Arizona? It’d mean the world to me.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-aug24.5UjS4b&refcode=em240808-1-120&t=1&akid=5839%2E6688874%2E5HNX2U)

Kamala Harris has proven herself to be a thoughtful and forceful leader in the fight to end America’s gun violence epidemic. From leading the Office of Gun Violence Prevention at the White House -- the first of its kind -- to helping pass the first major federal gun law in 30 years, Vice President Harris has shown her commitment to preventing senseless gun violence and making our communities safer. Meanwhile, we know who Donald Trump is: a dangerous demagogue who wants to take us back in time, strip us of our fundamental rights, and pander to the extremist gun lobby. _We can’t let that happen._ We need people who will stand up to Trump and his cronies and _fight for us._ We need bold thinkers who can inspire young people and create the future that we know we deserve. _Those people are Kamala Harris and Tim Walz._ Peter, the work to mobilize young people across the country to support Vice President Harris and Governor Tim Walz is happening now -- not in September or October -- it’s already underway. Young voters’ excitement across the internet and in battleground states is palpable, but we must turn this enthusiasm into votes. That means supporting folks on the ground doing the work to highlight the contrast between their hopeful vision for the future and Trump’s Project 2025 agenda that would take us backward. **I’m determined to do everything I can to ensure Kamala and Tim are elected in November -- and I’m asking you to join me, Peter.** [**Will you rush a $25 donation to Kamala and Tim’s campaign right now and be part of this historic movement? Team: if you've been with us for a while, you know all about the voter suppression laws passed in states like Florida, Georgia, Texas, and more.
Among the new, suppressive restrictions on drop boxes, mail-in voting, line warming, and other tools that help people vote came another -- tight restrictions on 3rd party groups like ours that help register new voters and deep penalties against 3rd party voter registration groups for their work.
The bad news? It's working . Florida's law in particular has curtailed pro-voter organizations from hiring staff and helping people register to vote. It's also led to a downturn in their fundraising, making it harder for them to do their other work to defend voting rights.
Instead of coordinating volunteers to go door-to-door ahead of the election or sending them to events around these states to help register eligible voters, organizations like ours are stuck trying to figure out how to help people vote without incurring $250,000 fines. It's plainly unacceptable.

Most of you know what Swift Boat Veterans for Truth did to John Kerry back in 2004. For those of you that don’t, the GOP engaged in a false, corrosive, disgusting campaign attacking John Kerry’s service in the Vietnam War.
#
Peter —
Most of you know what Swift Boat Veterans for Truth did to John Kerry back in 2004.
For those of you that don’t, the GOP engaged in a false, corrosive, disgusting campaign attacking John Kerry’s service in the Vietnam War.
They did it because they could. They got away with it because they could. In doing so they maligned the service and honor of not just John Kerry, but all Veterans. Because if they come after one of us, they’re coming after all of us.
The GOP is trying to do the same thing to Tim Walz right now. **The same guy who led the Switfboaters in 2004 is literally Trump’s campaign manager.** Seriously.
But there is one, big difference this time: We are here.
We are not going to let them do it. We are not going to let them get away with it. And we are certainly not going to sit by silently while Republicans spit on the service of millions of Veterans by attacking Tim Walz.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-aug24.ccu_CS&refcode=em240808-1-30&t=1&akid=26287%2E3013755%2EdF9SKm)
**The FACTS are that Tim Walz served for 24 years** — reenlisting for four more years after 9/11 — and put in for retirement months before his unit ever received their notification of deployment. He was honorably discharged in May of 2005. His unit received their orders for deployment in July of 2005, and they deployed in March of 2006 — fully staffed, fully sourced.
**The FACTS are that the Minnesota National Guard has confirmed that Tim Walz was a Command Sergeant Major,** and have emphasized that he can be referred to as Command Sergeant Major.
ANYTHING ELSE — from the GOP, from Trump, from Vance, from the media — is dissembling. It's a distraction. It’s bullshit. Excuse the language, but this is important.
**These attacks are bullshit. Period.**
It’s going to take a massive team to fight back against them, though. Tim and Kamala need our help. We are their back up. And we need you now.
[**Make a donation to VoteVets so we can continue correcting the record on Tim Walz’s service, and continue fighting against the lies from Trump, Vance, and the MAGA-right.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-aug24.ccu_CS&refcode=em240808-1-30&t=2&akid=26287%2E3013755%2EdF9SKm)**

| **ICYMI: Meet Republican Senate candidate Ian Cain**
Hannah LossAugust 07, 2024[Listen Here](https://cainforus.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d43ce56ef89bc59b1de5a39e8&id=2e4bfd73b2&e=76cb22207d)
_“Ian Cain is a product of Greater Boston. He’s a fourth-generation Quincy resident whose parents met at the storied Boston bar Daisy Buchanan’s. He went to preschool in the Back Bay and was educated at Boston College High School and Boston College._
_“Now, the Quincy City Council chairman is hoping to unseat Sen. Elizabeth Warren.”_ _..._ _“Cain was elected to Quincy City Council in 2015 and is now in his fifth term. Before that he worked in venture capital and private equity in real estate, telecommunications, technology and energy.”_ _..._ _“**‘I’m not running to be a partisan. That is the problem with Elizabeth Warren is that she is so partisan,’** he told Boston Public Radio on Wednesday. Cain said Warren’s past run for president and focus on national issues makes her “out of touch” with Massachusetts residents.”_ _..._ _“Cain said when he talks to voters, the two biggest issues that matter to them are immigration and the economy._
_“He said the bipartisan immigration bill that failed to pass in Congress —_[ _which Warren voted against_](https://cainforus.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d43ce56ef89bc59b1de5a39e8&id=291e39eda2&e=76cb22207d) _— did not get at the root of the immigration problem._
_“ ‘**That there’s physical and financial burdens that are being put upon the commonwealth of Massachusetts, which are putting us at a strain. And then we’re neglecting those who are most vulnerable in our society now that our shelter system is overburdened,’** he said._
_“For the economy, Cain said there should be more “alternative pathways for prosperity” besides college, like short-term training programs in cybersecurity and fiber, and training for a job in the trades._
_“**‘It mostly comes down to how can we enable and empower people to live better and more productive lives. And that’s what I’m focused on,’** he said.”_
Read more [here](https://cainforus.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d43ce56ef89bc59b1de5a39e8&id=a322b31d74&e=76cb22207d).

body:
If we’re going to defend our democracy and defeat Trump and Kari Lake this year we have to turn out Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike in Arizona.
#

Peter -
Check out this picture.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240808-1-90&t=1&akid=2827%2E734936%2E731oPy)
Republicans and Independents for Gallego might surprise you, given how divided our country is right now. But if you have a minute, I hope you’ll let me explain why this program is absolutely critical to our success.
Arizona is probably the most purple state in the country. For decades it was practically a given that Republicans had statewide elections here completely locked down. But over the last six years, things started changing.
We worked hard. We organized. And we had some victories in Arizona in 2018, more in 2020, and more again in 2022. In each of those victories it took Republicans and Independents voting their conscience — not their party — to get us over the top. It takes a broad coalition here, and it’s because of them that Mark Kelly is in the Senate and Donald Trump is out of the White House.
That is still the case in 2024, and if we’re going to defend our democracy and defeat Trump and Kari Lake this year we have to turn out Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike in Arizona.
Running a campaign like that isn’t easy — or cheap. We have to go everywhere and speak to everyone. But it’s what we have to do if we’re going to have any chance, and we’ve only gotten this far thanks to an incredible team.
And to be completely honest with you, I never thought I’d need to ask people who have already done so much for our campaign to do more. But today... that’s what I need to do.
Our fundraising just hasn’t been as strong as we need it to be. We expected August to be one of our strongest fundraising months ever, but right now we’re tracking far behind.
To help get back on track, I need you to chip in.

clean_body: If we’re going to defend our democracy and defeat Trump and Kari Lake this year we have to turn out Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike in Arizona. Peter - Check out this picture. Republicans and Independents for Gallego might surprise you, given how divided our country is right now. But if you have a minute, I hope you’ll let me explain why this program is absolutely critical to our success. Arizona is probably the most purple state in the country. For decades it was practically a given that Republicans had statewide elections here completely locked down. But over the last six years, things started changing. We worked hard. We organized. And we had some victories in Arizona in 2018, more in 2020, and more again in 2022. In each of those victories it took Republicans and Independents voting their conscience — not their party — to get us over the top. It takes a broad coalition here, and it’s because of them that Mark Kelly is in the Senate and Donald Trump is out of the White House. That is still the case in 2024, and if we’re going to defend our democracy and defeat Trump and Kari Lake this year we have to turn out Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike in Arizona. Running a campaign like that isn’t easy — or cheap. We have to go everywhere and speak to everyone. But it’s what we have to do if we’re going to have any chance, and we’ve only gotten this far thanks to an incredible team. And to be completely honest with you, I never thought I’d need to ask people who have already done so much for our campaign to do more. But today... that’s what I need to do. body:
Peter-
I was just officially declared the winner of the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Michigan.
And Trump-endorsed Mike Rogers was declared the winner of the Republican primary.
That means we have our general election match-up.
It's on. And the less than 90 day sprint to November has begun.
I'll have more to say about Mike Rogers and what happens next in the coming days. But for now, I am going to spend some time thanking supporters and volunteers who have gathered together in Detroit to celebrate our victory.
While that happens, I'll be keeping a close eye on our fundraising numbers tonight. With everything going on in politics, our opponent will get a boost, and we need one too. This is a big moment for the country, and both of our Senate campaigns. And the candidate whose supporters show up most will have a big advantage. So I am asking:
Can you take all of the positive energy of this moment and help me get the general election off to a strong start by splitting a $10 contribution between Fight for Progress and my campaign for U.S. Senate? body:

Why America Matters | ACI

Are you worried about the rising influence of radical
ideologies in today's schools?

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWB4WkGW3N

Fellow American,

Are you worried about the rising influence of
radical ideologies in today's schools? I know I am.

That's why I have created the Little Patriots
Program. This program provides curriculum for grades K-5 that
teaches the REAL history of America, promoting the values of
faith, liberty, community, and life that made our nation great.

This innovative approach makes learning history fun
for our children while instilling in them a profound love and
respect for our country.

But, in order to keep this curriculum free of
charge, I need your support.

I have written a book, Why America Matters.
Intended for young readers, this book creates a deeper
understanding of the importance of our country and the respect
that it deserves.

I want to send you a copy for a gift of $25 or
more. To give a gift use this secure link:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/why-america-matters-donate

All proceeds from your donation will go directly to
supporting our Little Patriots Program, ensuring that we can keep
creating curricula and cartoons that show the history of America.

You can help shape the minds of our future leaders
today and give them the best possible resources.

Your gift of $25 or more will get you access to my
book, Why America Matters, and help us reach more children with
the truth.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

Founder and Chairman

Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our
mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious
liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and

society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's
citizens.

Hello,
In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.
Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”
Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90450693/490549535/1610638071?refcode=em20240808mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=86414f42-9f55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQxNGY0Mi05ZjU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XjlpPDgmQDFjdwFqmq81U69piIR2lWByUUWBMiThocY=)

But that was not true. Since that ruling, we’ve seen oppressive voter ID laws and gerrymandering all over this country. And now, our own Secretary of State has sided with election deniers to try and nullify certain Montanans votes in favor of her own political views in the November election. Let me be clear: the Secretary of State must never put their party ahead of the job they were elected to do. Free and fair elections are the bedrock of our democracy and trying to affect the voter rolls for political purposes decreases public faith in that system. I pledge to you that I will always defend our democracy, maintain free and fair elections, and be accountable for my own actions. Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=53b0c5cb21f34c719264616f464c7064&_e=7jr3dSdcPKTaYhcfIBQkn3v7mU8vrsPZg9_OIlJwF8VLhOj7-MDMP-YKO1hS5iUA5_CZulYYv8e7roAo8Il-L8zsCHfK8H8sMoIxjQr9b3evrMTNcvQBw-noLMdY82uaSkZ67DOHedcFzHd85u6NZ1RbgSruekVK7NvlCtAjZa3S0Ta08WALuY6xLFdmtS1nGTScx_1CVkTdxRtjeHbhp88C8n5ZZte4jUYovdRycdOvPRs_NNVj4NqKJ3Y8kaZ0WVQHKtr4_6aFIp60NR6DvfB6TAh61r76m572EmrQ9RxJ50xj41jZCw2atL3YRLum8_cKXc-vPQmhVDihQfreNE45DzWzmVOBu38nK-urpekti3VKiUS5Hi_Kyrbb7Xoi)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=53b0c5cb21f34c719264616f464c7064&_e=7jr3dSdcPKTaYhcfIBQkn3v7mU8vrsPZg9_OIlJwF8VLhOj7-MDMP-YKO1hS5iUA5_CZulYYv8e7roAo8Il-L8zsCHfK8H8sMoIxjQr9b3evrMTNcvQBw-noLMdY82uaSkZ67DOHedcFzHd85u6NZ1RbgSruekVK7NvlCtAjZa3S0Ta08WALuY6xLFdmtS1nGTScx_1CVkTdxRtjeHbhp6vVeHAigD-vFG3jOwk6aNrpvwGxdjnPrdUj2skpMzSucvTtvsZ9EARV582naO_lQxpKWYzI9xdaFIDOxYnF5YmrrvUigxE0_zdf4ZeXjTYD9rhx5mSfb7-JLdQoUJx_aKX8k-EBu9ntjdN2hqdQSGvmTDNTezxM8DohiFmJyFOH) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Jasmyn Jordan

Last week, President Biden published an op-ed in _The Washington Post_ outlining his bold plans to add integrity and accountability to the courts. I’m excited by these plans. We must fix the courts. We cannot let Justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito fundamentally alter the trajectory of our judicial branch — and our country’s history.

body:
I have a meeting with President Trump on Friday afternoon, and he will ask me how much money I’m raising. |
---

Fellow American,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump tomorrow. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 89 days before Election Day.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=09e98143d7214ba7aac8778851a7637b&_e=VXKmCkNiLyBX5HhBVYZszBQTlpkub9cvRB33tv_1u8jB8g0Ukh4-HXIQnZhELrbZSdNSvyNocbSTj0-ZHuxCzDJ6-4au2aedhaHqXD8Y6BjrauDbVc4SQk24rS5vyg_MMde9gVUccl1ExXADsrobcb8JKdPBVytd1flMgwbdIIf4blWr63WzYD-UjXQvRWytUBI6sAfYgRmeEANHhh2F9MQo0lu_MNf0PUjG8_UbkVvo2hk5rfv4_XXKKeZU3ZBGelyVIjnkQHqaYW0seDYwe3mTlAkhbtlowQjyNkqooB-J2r0OLzmO_Wd2biAbjSRSLIy08sfE52X2iiVUuWRvrHXLQCarFPAhUTboZlqpe05vSucpjNayGzCQPjczd6DaVRKyDUMYpTBYcLOLWZWQ1FS1m60F0cbMj5WrLoiBU2U%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

The proof is in the polling. **Just today, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. **

You see, President Trump is doing me a huge favor by coming here to rally support. But despite record-breaking fundraising in July, **we’ve lost steam in the first eight days of August.**

That’s why on Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down.**[As of this morning, we’re still $27,875 short.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=09e98143d7214ba7aac8778851a7637b&_e=VXKmCkNiLyBX5HhBVYZszBQTlpkub9cvRB33tv_1u8jB8g0Ukh4-HXIQnZhELrbZSdNSvyNocbSTj0-ZHuxCzDJ6-4au2aedhaHqXD8Y6BjrauDbVc4SQk24rS5vyg_MMde9gVUccl1ExXADsrobcb8JKdPBVytd1flMgwbdIIf4blWr63WzYD-UjXQvRWytUBI6sAfYgRmeEANHhh2F9MQo0lu_MNf0PUjG8_UbkVvo2hk5rfv4_XXKKeZU3ZBGelyVIjnkQHqaYW0seDYwe18vBCEYeJB8AYLUUkusSLa98hDwgHKdW3eFIeGYj_xIm_bmNqR0L86GlD8swRvBuQWXA5Q83DDDO5-y0DT-W7ls1f4csV1fX1hKAnR75wIMLQaeus85vy5FIVOiE3w5RYR3d0EuAH85kc-2xooj8m0%3D)** I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him our fundraising has tanked this month.

[**CONTRIBUTE BEFORE TIM'S MEETING WITH TRUMP ->**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=09e98143d7214ba7aac8778851a7637b&_e=VXKmCkNiLyBX5HhBVYZszBQTlpkub9cvRB33tv_1u8jB8g0Ukh4-HXIQnZhELrbZSdNSvyNocbSTj0-ZHuxCzDJ6-4au2aedhaHqXD8Y6BjrauDbVc4SQk24rS5vyg_MMde9gVUccl1ExXADsrobcb8JKdPBVytd1flMgwbdIIf4blWr63WzYD-UjXQvRWytUBI6sAfYgRmeEANHhh2F9MQo0lu_MNf0PUjG8_UbkVvo2hk5rfv4_XXKKeZU3ZBGelyVIjnkQHqaYW0seDYwewrVSuoNJb4esu3qCdpKPmDfkltJbgpXk7KLsz3RGbYpyNyL4XUtDdxj_1oLyNrZ2AKaEg1cYLEi48gWuNYQEmB9DHS488_B7Nm6bifq3F4nhGbzZDjniUAsBfpZVag2diEeOZcKOz55Z8fZhOhFKzU%3D)
President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ _**How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival?**_ ”

I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month.

**[I simply cannot tell him we’re down 20% month over month.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=09e98143d7214ba7aac8778851a7637b&_e=VXKmCkNiLyBX5HhBVYZszBQTlpkub9cvRB33tv_1u8jB8g0Ukh4-HXIQnZhELrbZSdNSvyNocbSTj0-ZHuxCzDJ6-4au2aedhaHqXD8Y6BjrauDbVc4SQk24rS5vyg_MMde9gVUccl1ExXADsrobcb8JKdPBVytd1flMgwbdIIf4blWr63WzYD-UjXQvRWytUBI6sAfYgRmeEANHhh2F9MQo0lu_MNf0PUjG8_UbkVvo2hk5rfv4_XXKKeZU3ZBGelyVIjnkQHqaYW0seDYwewpDaGOpaWND48m-UOKNjNUGUY0lBj999HMibQgXiL1hDVZghYaX6FU7vwBjCSXn4TGmxNUYKVeAA0eoukQGvpbJdesRVfDrs9jnov19qgreXxSn6N0aCPlRdg42cJIWT6hOVTh9SPV2jP8wGwQvCMM%3D)**

clean_body: I have a meeting with President Trump on Friday afternoon, and he will ask me how much money I’m raising. | Fellow American, On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump tomorrow. In case you missed it, President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state. The proof is in the polling. Just today, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. You see, President Trump is doing me a huge favor by coming here to rally support. But despite record-breaking fundraising in July, we’ve lost steam in the first eight days of August. That’s why on Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down. I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him our fundraising has tanked this month. President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival? ” I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month. |
# On to the General Election!
---
| After Tuesday’s primary election, it’s official: Dr Garcia is the sole challenger to the incumbent, Sen. Maria Cantwell.
As we transition into the general election, voters will get to know Dr Garcia more and learn about his priorities: [the fentanyl crisis, rising crime, the weak economy and high cost of living, and OB-GYN shortages in parts of Washington](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=1c757f443b&e=3ed3552a03).
Additionally, Sen. Cantwell will finally have to defend her record and her failure to spend significant time in communities throughout the state.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | Dr Garcia’s positions and approach to governing are moderate and centrist, thus far more appealing to swing voters than previous GOP U.S. Senate candidates. He will draw clear contrasts between himself and Sen. Cantwell, pointing out her lack of attention to and effective action on the problems facing the people of Washington.
---
|
---
| The Seattle Times editorial board in July called Dr Garcia “[a sensible moderate](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=7913e135b4&e=3ed3552a03)”. In its primary night news coverage, the Times noted that “[Cantwell is more of a partisan](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=e567a80d86&e=3ed3552a03)”.
The Spokesman-Review [reported that](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=030eea2598&e=3ed3552a03) “[i]n the next 90 days of campaigning before the general election, Garcia intends to appeal to independent, moderate and conservative Democrat voters with more moderate policies than the incumbent, especially surrounding the fentanyl crisis, government spending and the economy. ‘Our campaign has more of a moderate message than the senator does. I feel she has represented her own ideology the last six years.’”
To read Raul’s primary night news release, [click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=4d4706bae4&e=3ed3552a03).
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=03206bf599&e=3ed3552a03)
|
---
|
# We Need YOUR Support to Win
---
| With less than three months until the November general election, your financial support is absolutely critical to helping Dr Garcia make his case to Washington voters.
Please contribute to our mission to bring new leadership to Washington state! [Your donation of $5, $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can give, will make the difference in electing Raul and defeating Sen. Cantwell in November](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=8849416cd2&e=3ed3552a03).
Thank you so much for your support — together, we can win for Washington!
---
[DONATE TODAY!](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=862bd4612f&e=3ed3552a03)
|
---
|
# Why We Need New Leadership in the U.S. Senate:
---
|
## _WA’s Extremely High Cost of Living_
---
| Economic worries are at top of mind for Washington voters. Inflation is hitting Washingtonians hard, wiping out savings and stretching people’s finances to the breaking point.
Washington routinely ranks as one of the most expensive states in the nation. Dr Garcia will stand up against the reckless federal spending that has sent our national debt to dangerous levels and made the cost of living for consumers spiral out of control.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=dfa6f4505c&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| [](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=314e96e393&e=3ed3552a03)
---
| Sen. Cantwell has not only done nothing to address the inflation crisis, she keeps voting for reckless federal spending. She’s making the problem worse, saddling us, our children and our grandchildren with crippling debt. And she continues to ignore the economic suffering of Washingtonians who are paying extremely high prices for food, gas, housing, childcare, healthcare and more.
Dr Garcia will be a voice for economic growth that lowers prices for consumers, and for fiscal sanity in Washington, D.C.

We must continue to work to elect candidates up and down the ballot who will dare to say that Palestinians deserve to live and that our government must stop funding war crimes. Even in the face of Cori’s electoral defeat, there is still hope and we are still building power. For example, two of our endorsed pro-ceasefire candidates won their primaries yesterday in Michigan. Tonya Myers Phillips is an attorney for economic and social justice who protects tenants’ rights in Detroit and across the state. Tonya won her Democratic primary election for State Representative and will move on to the general election. State Representative Dylan Wegela also won his Democratic primary. Dylan is a school teacher and one of only 24 Michigan legislators who sent a letter to President Biden last November demanding a permanent ceasefire. In a state where 93% of state lawmakers have taken money from the utility monopoly DTE, Dylan is championing legislation to ban utility corporations from giving political contributions. I founded our Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to support fearless working class and progressive candidates who want to run for office to champion the rights of marginalized people. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria]
The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep Virginia blue! —Tim
Hi folks, my name is Gloria Witt, and I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in Virginia’s 5th District.
Our rights and fundamental freedoms are on the ballot in November, and I’m running to energize voters in this community and build bridges to advance legislation for ‘we the people.’
I’m proud to have the endorsement of Senator Tim Kaine, and as one of his longtime supporters, I need to ask for your help today: Will you split a donation of any amount between Senator Kaine’s re-election campaign and my campaign for Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria]
I know what voters in this district care about because I’m one of them – I’m a country girl born and raised right here in Amherst. I grew up on a small farm that lacked running water, and from an early age, I was involved in all aspects of farm life. Starting when I was 14, I worked in the tobacco fields in the summers and eventually saved up enough money to buy my own car when I was 18.
My father pushed me to pursue a college degree after high school. He was a union steelworker who never got the chance to finish school, and he knew the difference an education could make in my life.
While I grew up in this region and know firsthand the struggles we face, my experience has also taught me that good leadership begins with listening. In this campaign, I’m leading with my values – family, faith, education, justice, and community building – and I’m listening to the needs of my community so I can fight for them while in Congress.
That means upholding our democracy, expanding access to voting, restoring reproductive rights, and ensuring our freedoms are protected against all forms of discrimination. It means creating smart economic growth in our communities, addressing the gun violence epidemic, and creating affordable childcare.
This is what’s at stake in November. I’m committed to protecting our freedoms, bringing positive change to our community, and to creating more opportunities to thrive and grow.
But I’m going to need your help. Will you help make sure my campaign is ready to win in November by making a split donation to me and Tim Kaine today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria]
Thank you for your support and for helping keep Virginia blue up and down the ticket this November.
Sincerely,
Gloria

Kennedy Jr. revealed a bold vision for Bitcoin's integration into the American economy. US Government as a Major Bitcoin Holder: Transfer the approximately 200,000 Bitcoin held by the US government to the US Treasury Eliminate Taxes on Bitcoin Transactions: Issue public guidelines that transactions between Bitcoin and the US dollar are unreportable and non-taxable Incentivize Green Energy Production through Bitcoin Mining: Leverage Bitcoin mining to incentivize investments in green and renewable energy production Strengthen the US Dollar: Restore the dollar's dominance in global finance and address national debt Oppose Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs): Prevent the adoption of CBDCs that could lead to increased government surveillance and control | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Internal and national polls show RFK Jr. leading Trump in a head-to-head race and maintaining high favorability ratings.
