Abby stresses the importance of brave leadership and justice, suggesting a two-state solution and a future-focused approach Dan critiques Netanyahu's leadership, highlighting his negative impact on the peace process and Israel's governance The discussion emphasizes the need for new Palestinian leadership and U.S. support to address regional threats and achieve peace Why It Matters:** Understanding the complexities of Israeli-Palestinian relations and leadership dynamics is crucial for enabling global stability. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Be a part of the Volunteer Social Media Dream Team!Whether its simply commenting on Kennedy posts or helping to admin a state page, social media is one of our most important tools to spread Kennedy's policies, platforms, and passion to voters.We are looking for volunteers to admin state pages and groups for Facebook instagram TikTok and X.Please DO NOT create new pages without coming to this meeting first and checking that a page doesn't already exist. We do not want to split our supporters as our greatest strength on social media is in high numbers. Please to come to this meeting prepared to help with an existing page or group.Commitment is about 30 minutes a day to admin a page or moderate a group or any amount of time to generally promote content.We will go over all the ways you can help even if its just occasionally and especially if you would like the honor of showcasing Kennedy's support in your state.This meeting will be heavy on demo with time for questions at the end. Please save your personal anecdotes til the very end so we can cover lots of territory. Team,
There's no way to sugarcoat this: A major party is advocating for a constitutional change in Texas that would codify their power and control into the state constitution. From the Austin American-Statesman:
" The Texas Republican Party platform now calls for a state constitutional amendment to create another requirement for winning statewide office: In addition to winning the most votes statewide, a candidate would have to win a majority of the votes in a majority of Texas’ 254 counties. "
This would create a mini-Electoral College just within Texas itself, with one vote for each county. Harris County, home to Houston and nearly 5 million people, would count exactly the same as Loving County, whose population during the 2020 census was recorded as 64 people .
For example, Texas' current governor won reelection with only 55% of the popular vote but "won" 235 counties. This constitutional amendment, if passed, would guarantee no other party could win a statewide election without taking away all those rural, deeply conservative counties. Opponents of voting rights want to use land, not people, to keep themselves in power permanently.
They're openly advocating for anti-democratic rules to limit the impact of people's votes just because they want to stay in control, Team. I never imagined that I would be here today, friend. I’m a Jewish-Ukrainian immigrant whose family came to America to find hope like so many others, and I was proud to join the military and serve my country. When my brother, Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman, and I witnessed President Trump abuse his power and threaten to block Ukraine’s military aid unless they investigated Joe Biden, we refused to stay silent. We reported the call up the chain of command and it eventually led to his impeachment, but it cost us our careers when we were fired in retaliation. Back then, **I never envisioned I would run for Congress** , but in the nearly five years since that phone call, the Republicans have shown the dangerous path they are willing to tread. From the insurrection of January 6th to their assaults on fair elections and fundamental rights, Republicans have gone all-in on authoritarianism. Now, our democracy teeters on the brink. That's why I need your support today. Our race is one of the key few that will determine party control of the House. So we can’t fall behind on our fundraising if we want to beat the GOP and keep our democracy out of the dangerous hands of MAGA Republicans. The path to winning the House majority runs through VA-7, and the only way we can win is if I have you by my side. [**Can you please split a contribution between Serve America and my campaign today and join us in our fight against the far-right? We need all the help we can get to win this seat and protect our democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90462222/490590017/-1537968876?refcode=240807&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZWNlMjFkNi1iMTU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qUuI6wp4hzAmhbO6KX0iDRFJCU257YJbU8r2ZqZyqIs=) I’m running because I believe it’s the duty of those in office to put the needs of their communities and their country over everything else. Because it’s our duty to step up and defend our democratic rights. I hope you’re with me. — Eugene Vindma [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90462223/490590018/191792663?refcode=240807&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZWNlMjFkNi1iMTU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qUuI6wp4hzAmhbO6KX0iDRFJCU257YJbU8r2ZqZyqIs=)

Dear Peter,
On July 12, at FreedomFest, I warned if we don’t end our cold civil war, the country would descend into political violence.
The next day, there was an assassination attempt on President Trump, but thankfully, he survived.
[Sadly, since the shooting, the hateful and unhinged name-calling typical of our broken, political culture has only worsened – on both sides. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-2024?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_8_24_uno1&n=5)
Many of us want to get off this collision course. For ourselves, our neighbors and our children.
The reason why this is so critical is because the political assault on the soul of our country that keeps us divided, keeps us distracted from the monumental corruption of our system in plain sight.
In the last election, **the two parties spent over $12 billion dollars** selling off the seats of power in Washington to the highest bidder.
This peak corruption has left us with a government and an economy rigged to exploit the many and build the outsized wealth of a few.
As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America.
This perversion distorts and inverts our national priorities, casts aside the people’s interest and has led to decades of war, chronic disease and a devastated middle class.
[If you elect me President, I will end the forever wars and cut our wasteful defense spending in half which will still leave us with an annual defense budget that far outstrips Russia and China’s combined. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-2024?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_8_24_uno1&n=6)
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-2024?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_8_24_uno1&n=7)
---
To rebuild our Middle Class and your power in our democracy, we will reinvest the trillions saved in our Main Street economy, small business, our infrastructure and struggling communities.
This will create millions of new jobs annually and stoke an economic boom. Our tax base will expand. We’ll pay down the debt and restore fiscal sanity.
**Life in America can and will be affordable again if you help elect me President.**
Over the last 40 years while party politicians have been cozying up to big money, I’ve spent those decades fighting the corporate contamination of our environment and corruption of our system.
[Send me to Washington and I will clean house.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-2024?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_8_24_uno1&n=8)
This election is not about left vs right. It’s about all Americans of good will coming together to end the tyranny of corruption in our system so we can build back America, strong.
**We’ve given the Democrats a chance to fix this country. We’ve given Republicans a chance. What has not had a chance is a unity government, headed by an independent President.**
I am beholden to no party. I am free from corporate influence, owing no favors to the Washington establishment, and ready to recruit the best ideas from all those who have been left out.
[It’s long past time we put people before politics and country before party.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-2024?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_8_24_uno1&n=9)

My dad immigrated to this country and went from working in the fields to later serving in the military then to becoming a police officer. My parents worked day and night to show me that with hard work, anything is possible. They bent over backwards for our family, like so many parents do for their kids. But no matter how hard they worked, it wasn’t enough to pay for my education. So I channeled their spirit and worked multiple jobs while in college to earn my degree. Then, when my daughter was born, I knew I had to take that same spirit and work to create change in my community — building a future where she’d have the opportunity to fulfill her dreams. So, I went to work on the frontlines in Oregon to secure more affordable health care, a higher minimum wage, lower prescription drug prices for hardworking families like mine, and historic legislation protecting abortion rights in our state. Now, I’m fighting every day in Congress to protect our democracy, defend our fundamental freedoms, and build an economy that puts working families before wealthy corporations. clean_body: = = I learned the power of hard work at an early age from my parents. My dad immigrated to this country and went from working in the fields to later serving in the military then to becoming a police officer. My parents worked day and night to show me that with hard work, anything is possible. They bent over backwards for our family, like so many parents do for their kids. But no matter how hard they worked, it wasn’t enough to pay for my education. So I channeled their spirit and worked multiple jobs while in college to earn my degree. Then, when my daughter was born, I knew I had to take that same spirit and work to create change in my community — building a future where she’d have the opportunity to fulfill her dreams. Children in our nation are facing the brunt of the American gun violence epidemic.
#

Team, we shouldn’t live in a country where this is a news headline:
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240808-1-30&t=1&akid=8671%2E3935704%2EH_0WH0)
According to new CDC data, although gun deaths fell overall last year, they rose for children under 18. Even with a decrease in overall gun deaths in 2023, over 46,000 people died from gun violence in our nation. That’s a number that should shock and disturb us all.
**_When will enough be enough?_**
Parents shouldn’t have to worry that when they send their child to school, they may be the next victim of a mass shooting. Children shouldn’t be able to easily access firearms in their households, creating an opportunity for them to harm themselves or others.
Children in our nation are facing the brunt of the American gun violence epidemic. Gun violence is the NUMBER ONE cause of death for children and teens in America. Lawmakers who refuse to tackle this deadly crisis are failing our children. We must do better.
[**We won’t rest here at GIFFORDS PAC until we see a future where our children can live freely without the fear of gun violence. Will you please make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to help fuel our work to end gun violence and protect our kids?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240808-1-30&t=2&akid=8671%2E3935704%2EH_0WH0)

TELL CONGRESS TO REJECT ENVIRONMENTAL CUTS AND BIG OIL GIVEAWAYS

After the recent decisions in Trump v. United States, Ohio v. EPA, and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo, grassroots activists around the country are calling for action to stop the
MAGA Justices’ power grab on behalf of far-right special interests, which will
have devastating consequences for our environment and health.

Congress has the authority to hold the Supreme Court accountable and to set the
number of Justices on the Court. It’s past time for lawmakers to expand and rebalance the Court — help us deliver 10,000 signatures calling for immediate action. https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6BPv- Peter — the MAGA Justices on the captured Supreme Court just put Donald
Trump above the law and grabbed even more power to serve special interests at
the expense of Americans’ right to breathe clean air, to drink clean water, to
exercise a truly equal right to vote, and to make fundamental reproductive
health decisions. This week, shockingly the MAGA Supreme Court granted immunity in Trump vs. the United Statesand put our very democracy at risk because for democracy to endure, no one –
especially not the president – can be above the law. In Ohio v. EPA and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo, they made it even harder for scientists and experts at agencies like the EPA
to protect the air we breathe and the water we drink — and even easier for
billionaires and corporate interests like Big Oil to get their way. Billionaires
and corporations have showered MAGA Justices on the Supreme Court with luxury
gifts and travel, and oil billionaire Charles Koch even backed some of the
lawyers who brought these anti-environment cases. Once again, those investments
paid off. Peter — for the sake of our communities, our democracy and our planet,
it’s past time to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. Sign our petition to Congress right now. It only takes a moment to help us reach our 10,000 signature goal >> https://links.messages.lcv. Adding seats to the Supreme Court would allow the president to appoint new
justices who will work for the people, not deep-pocketed polluters and MAGA
extremists. Following the news, there has been a groundswell of grassroots
activism around the country — an outcry for change on the Court. Today, we’re calling on all LCV members to submit a message to their lawmakers in
Congress in support of the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme

name: Sarah McBride
subject: These 7 words break my heart
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Democrat or Republican or Independent, progressive or conservative or moderate — the worst thing we can do when someone tells us they are in pain is to diminish it.
#
**"It's not as bad as you think."**
So often I see people pull out those 7 little words when responding to people in pain. **And I have to tell you — Democrat or Republican or Independent, progressive or conservative or moderate — the worst thing we can do when someone tells us they are in pain is to dismiss it.**
But too often, we see a politics that pits our pain against each other. We see political leaders diminish the pain of those on the other side of the partisan divide.
When someone conveys, "It's not as bad as you think," what the person in pain hears is, "Your pain doesn't matter." It forces people to defend their pain, only making people angrier and more frustrated.
When our neighbor says they're worried about the cost of groceries and housing... that pain matters.
When our coworker says they think they might be making less because of their race or gender... that pain matters.
When our cousin says they are heartbroken by another opioid-related death in their community... that pain matters.
When our friend from high school who served in the military now can't get the care they need through the VA... that pain matters.
Everyone’s pain matters, regardless of their background or how they vote. People don’t have to be “right” for what they’re facing to be “wrong.” There is, unfortunately, enough pain to go around. And any therapist will tell you that the first step to healing is to have your pain seen.
**What we need are elected leaders who see that pain across difference and disagreement. And, instead of turning it into hate and bigotry to fuel an authoritarian power-grab, we need them to actually do something about it. That's what justice looks like.**
My opponents and even some well-intentioned supporters have tried to paint me as the voice for one community.
**But I'm not running just to be a voice for people who share my background or political beliefs. I'm going to fight for everyone — including people who don't understand me and might not fight for me. Because we can heal our political divides and deliver for all Delawareans.**

A couple weeks ago, we held our 2024 Campaign Kick Off event. We raised over $6,000 at our launch event, and had over 60 patriotic Coloradoans attend.
Now, it is time to get to work on saving our great state from the radical democrat agenda that has been forced on each of us with the Democrat super majority in the State House of representatives.

Earlier this year, we also helped elect three climate champions to the Salt River Project Board, positioning them to push for sustainable energy practices. And let’s not forget Jen Allen’s victory in the Pima County Board of Supervisors primary race! Jen will help usher in a just clean energy transition for Southern Arizona. In Michigan, we scored another clean sweep this week with our four endorsed climate champions for the state legislature winning their primary races! With razor-thin majorities in both chambers, these victories are crucial to maintaining recent progress on clean energy, environmental reforms, and protecting communities from the impacts of fossil fuel pollution. Our champions will continue to lead the way in climate policy, benefiting not just Michigan but the entire nation. In Colorado, our endorsed candidates Junie Joseph (State House District 10) and Elliott Hood (CU Regent At-Large) advanced in their primary races in June! They are ready to protect Colorado’s natural beauty and fight against the fossil fuel industry's harmful practices. In Texas, we made history when our endorsed candidate Molly Cook won the special election for District 15, making her the first openly LGBTQ+ member to serve in the Texas State Senate. In California, Igor Tregub won his race for Berkeley City Council, running on a platform to make Berkeley the nation’s climate leader. Several of our endorsed climate champions also came out on top in the California primary earlier this year, including five running for the state legislature and Laura Friedman, who triumphed in a 15-way primary to succeed Adam Schiff in Congress! body:
https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com]
Dear Friend,
Happy International Cat Day! Today, we celebrate our feline friends who bring joy, companionship, and a touch of mischief into our lives. As we honor our beloved cats, we also have the perfect opportunity to address a serious issue: the harmful rhetoric from individuals like JD Vance, who once claimed that the United States is "effectively run" by "a bunch of childless cat ladies who are miserable at their own lives and the choices they've made."
These comments are not just absurd—they’re deeply offensive. They disparage women, undermine their contributions, and reduce their value to outdated stereotypes. At the Tennessee Voter Project, we believe it’s time to push back against such harmful rhetoric and support leaders who represent the best of America: Kamala Harris and Tim Walz.
Why Kamala Harris and Tim Walz?
Kamala Harris and Tim Walz embody the principles of equality, justice, and progress. They stand for the values that make our country strong and inclusive. Harris, as our first female Vice President, has shattered glass ceilings and shown what true leadership looks like. Walz, with his proven track record as Governor of Minnesota, complements Harris with his dedication to public service and pragmatic solutions.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvp-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvp-2024]
Why the Tennessee Voter Project?
The Tennessee Voter Project was created to support candidates who share our vision of a fair and equitable America. By supporting the Harris-Walz ticket, we’re investing in a future where everyone’s voice is heard and respected. We’re working tirelessly to ensure that every Tennessean can exercise their right to vote and have a say in the direction of our country.
A Special Connection: Taylor Swift
Did you know that one of Tennessee’s most famous residents, Taylor Swift, is a proud cat owner? Her cats—Meredith, Olivia, and Benjamin—are adored by fans worldwide. On this International Cat Day, let’s take a page from Taylor’s book and stand up against the negative stereotypes that seek to divide us. Just as Swift uses her platform to advocate for change, we can use ours to support candidates who will lead us toward a brighter future.

# August 6th, 2024 marked 59 years since
the Voting Rights Act of 1965
---
Signed by President Lyndon B. Johnson, the Voting Rights Act of 1965 removed race-based restrictions on voting, and became a landmark federal law that would drastically change the country's political landscape.

On its 59th anniversary, we honor the advocacy of those who worked tirelessly to ensure its passage. However, voting rights are still at risk.U.S. Supreme Court cases such as 2013's Shelby County v. Holder, which removed protections that prevented state and local governments with histories of discrimination from adopting harmful election policies, demonstrate just how fragile our voting rights and freedom to vote are.

Voting rights are fundamental to securing all other rights and freedoms. Federal lawmakers must pass legislation like the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to strengthen voting rights laws and safeguard voters and elections.

In the meantime, we continue this work by educating our communities about their voting rights. The New Pennsylvania Project will tirelessly advocate to ensure our voting rights are protected here in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and across the country. We are on a mission to register every eligible Pennsylvanian to vote. **Do your part and honor the work of those who came before you -
use your right to vote!**

clean_body: | | | Hi Friend, Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, upcoming events, and exciting career opportunities. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress to eliminate voting barriers. We will continue to provide key election updates, and highlight the issues that shape Pennsylvania's future. As we gear up for the 2024 general election, we invite you to join us in our mission to mobilize voters to the polls in every election, and to make change in our communities. #WhenWeVoteWeWin | | | | | August 6th, 2024 marked 59 years since the Voting Rights Act of 1965 Signed by President Lyndon B. Johnson, the Voting Rights Act of 1965 removed race-based restrictions on voting, and became a landmark federal law that would drastically change the country's political landscape. On its 59th anniversary, we honor the advocacy of those who worked tirelessly to ensure its passage. However, voting rights are still at risk.U.S. Supreme Court cases such as 2013's Shelby County v. Holder, which removed protections that prevented state and local governments with histories of discrimination from adopting harmful election policies, demonstrate just how fragile our voting rights and freedom to vote are. Voting rights are fundamental to securing all other rights and freedoms. Federal lawmakers must pass legislation like the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to strengthen voting rights laws and safeguard voters and elections. In the meantime, we continue this work by educating our communities about their voting rights. The New Pennsylvania Project will tirelessly advocate to ensure our voting rights are protected here in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and across the country. We are on a mission to register every eligible Pennsylvanian to vote. Do your part and honor the work of those who came before you - use your right to vote! | | | | | We Talk Weekly (Episode 7/25/024) | | | | | | CEO Kadida Kenner joined the team of , Philly 106.5FM () to talk about the 2024 election, civic engagement, and civic education. | | | | | | | | NPP Block Party Tuesday, August 13th, 2024 5:30-8:00PM 2619 9th St, Chester, PA Join us in the City of Chester for a Block Party to celebrate our new headquarters grand opening! This is a family-friendly event with free food, sweet treats, activities for the kids, and of course, the opportunity to get registered to vote or check your voter's status. We will also have a screening of the documentary: Suppressed and Sabotaged. For more information email us at:info@newpaproject.org | | | Opening the Prison Cage: Unerasing Women Behind Bars Thursday, September 19th, 2024 5:30PM-8:30PM Parkway Central Library 1901 Vine St, Philadelphia, PA 19103 The evening will begin with a screening of the film "Kemba," which tells the harrowing yet inspiring story of Kemba Smith's journey from a college student to a federal prisoner, and her eventual pardon. The screening will be followed by a talk-back with Kemba Smith and Kadida Kenner. | | | | | NPP ON THE GROUND A busy Sunday in Philly! | | | Last Sunday, the NPP- Philly team visited Tattooed Mom while they hosted a voter drive featuring drag, prizes and fun! | | | | | | | | | On the same day , we held a college campus voter drive in West Philly.Did you know? "—and that number has the potential to increase in upcoming elections as colleges explore a variety of strategies to get their students to the polls, including initiatives like on-campus voter registration drives." This event gathered thought leaders, changemakers, and peace advocates throughout the Pennsylvania Region. | | | “The case was brought by the Black Political Empowerment Project, Common Cause and allied advocacy groups against the secretary of state and the elections boards in Philadelphia and Allegheny County, which includes Pittsburgh. They argued that enforcing the date requirement infringes upon voting rights and that none of the prior cases on the topic directly ruled whether it runs afoul of the state constitution’s Free and Equal Elections Clause.” “In a 12-6 decision, with all of the Republican-appointed judges in the majority, the appeals court overturned its own precedent dating back to 1988, ruling that minority groups who form a combined majority, such as Black and Hispanic voters in the Galveston area, are not protected under the VRA. That will make it much tougher to secure representation for communities of color.” “Jamie Walsh's attorney on Wednesday filed a brief in support of Walsh's appeal to the state Supreme Court regarding two provisional ballots cast in the April 23 Republican primary for the 117th District state House seat...This might be the last time Jamie Walsh files legal paperwork during a series of appeals from both Walsh and incumbent state Rep. Mike Cabell that has dragged on for three months since the primary.” “Keli M. Neary, Executive Deputy Attorney General for the Civil Law division of the Pennsylvania Office of Attorney General, has been nominated by President Joe Biden to the federal district court.” “Two points are crucial: First, term limits are the path to a fairer Court, a necessary structural fix for a broken appointment process. Second, they can be accomplished by statute, rather than constitutional amendment.” “When asked about the potential risks of expanding the court, Markey said it’s been done many times before. “The Court has been expanded seven times previously, including [by] President Lincoln and President John Adams,” Markey said. “So there is ample precedent for the expansion of the court. And, ultimately, the [U.S.] Constitution left it up to the United States Congress.” | "As misinformation about the U.S. election spreads across the internet, secretaries of state, including Pennsylvania’s Al Schmidt, are raising the alarm about two ways they say X owner Elon Musk may be contributing to the confusion. "As governor, Walz has staked out a lengthy policy record on voting and election issues, including an expansion of voting rights. Vance has had fewer opportunities to affect voting policy as a U.S. senator, but his statements on the subject over the last four years, including false claims about voter fraud, offer insight into his views. “Kamala Harris, the Democratic nominee for president, has selected Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz (D) as her running mate, she announced in a post on X. Harris has a strong record on voting rights, and so does Walz... In May 2023, Walz signed the “Democracy for the People Act,” which promoted voting rights in many ways, including by allowing 16- and 17-year-olds to pre-register to vote, permitting voters to opt into a permanent absentee voter list and expanding language access in voting materials.” “This year’s Pennsylvania state budget passed with little of last year’s chaos and delays — but, a vital program to fix up aging housing stock, and keep long-time homeowners in the homes they love, was once again passed up for funding. The loss of funding for Whole Home Repairs is a massive blow to Allegheny County and for the commonwealth as a whole.” “As the noisy worlds of X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and Truth Social have continued to pump out torrents of deceptions, distortions, and inaccuracies, experts tell us it’s more important than ever to learn how to recognize and reject misinformation. With the number of days until Nov. 5 dwindling, the magnitude of fabricated online political content is expected to expand and intensify.” “Led by state Reps. Aerion Abney, Napoleon Nelson, Rick Krajewski, Anthony Bellmon and Greg Scott, the Pennsylvania Legislative Black Caucus on Tuesday heard from Allegheny County officials over incarcerated peoples’ right to vote from jail.” “Pennsylvania law allows any resident to challenge the voter eligibility of anyone registered in the same municipality. Golembiewski recruited people in various municipalities to sign affidavits, creating what he calls an “assembly line” of paperwork, involving a number of notaries working pro bono and more than 16,000 two-page affidavits seeking the removal of voters.” “Passed in more than half of U.S. states, the laws are often part of sweeping bills that targeted multiple parts of the process, including absentee voting, early voting, and Election Day voting. ” “In the predominantly Latino city of Reading, residents say the latest events and changes to the national political scene are, as one person described it, "exciting" and "unexpected." Both parties are paying attention to this battleground state's growing number of Latino voters.” | | | | | | We're Hiring! name: Tim Walz
subject: Kamala and I need your support today to defeat Donald Trump and JD Vance
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
The only way we win this thing is if we stick together. | | |
---
Peter, Vice President Harris asked me to be her running mate this week. August 8, 2024
Chris Coyle, the Republican Town Chairman from Pomfret has endorsed Dr. Michael Goldstein. Although this may seem a bit out of the ordinary - Pomfret is a town of 4,250 residents in eastern Connecticut - everyone suffers in Connecticut due to the inflationary policies of the Biden/Harris/Himes administration. Mr. Coyle's statement is below.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd962927-62fc-4e7d-b8ed-349c1e1bf854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Pomfret Town Hall
Endorsement - Chris Coyle - Pomfret RTC Chair
**Michael Goldstein Offers a New and Energetic Leadership Style Based on Listening**
As a doctor and a lawyer, Michael Goldstein has built a successful career on his ability to listen and to solve problems.
**Why it matters: **Voters are tired of being lectured to and are seeking elected officials that will listen to them and address their concerns. The era of political ideology driving policy is coming to an end based on the increasingly obvious failures it has spawned. Electing a person who has served people with intelligence and compassion is the first step. _**Who has more compassion than a Doctor?**_
**Michael is that person:**
* Committed to our founding values and Constitutional rights and will stand up to those who would erode or infringe them. From protecting women athletes' rights to stopping the encroachment on our fundamental rights starting with Free Speech.
* Solution oriented. When have you seen such thoughtful and in-depth analysis of key issues facing our families and communities?
* Values Unite. Issues Divide. Michael understands that we must end the divisive and destructive politics of personal attack.

**Republicans can unite around Doctor Michael Goldstein because he is the best candidate to represent the communities of the 4th Congressional District in a way that is consistent with what families need and should expect from their elected officials.**
As a person born in Stamford and raised in Greenwich, with memories of our father supporting our local RTC, I am proud to endorse and support Michael Goldstein. **It is time we Put A Doctor In The House.** Please vote for Doctor Michael Goldstein on August 13th or now with the early voting available in your town.
Respectfully,
Chris Coyle
Chairman
Pomfret Republican Town Committee

| I can’t tell you how often it happens. I’m catching up with a friend, and they eventually say: _“We’re trying.”_

It’s usually an exciting moment. Sometimes, I can tell my friends are nervous. Too often, I can tell they’re in pain.

It’s hard to believe that in 2024, we’re still fighting to have the right to make some of the most important decisions in our lives. _**For many of my friends, that has meant the decision to pursue IVF treatments to start their families.**_

It’s a struggle too many families know well. Our nominee for Vice President, Governor Tim Walz, and his wife, Gwen, have experienced it. When I listened to Governor Walz share their story on Tuesday night, I was touched. And then I was angry.

**Too many Americans can’t access or afford the IVF treatments that could help start their own families.** Rather than fight to help people achieve their dreams, politicians like JD Vance want to ban IVF treatments, insulting the millions who struggle with fertility issues each day.

clean_body: It’s hard to believe that in 2024 we’re still fighting for women like me and my friends to have the right to make some of the most important decisions in our lives. | = | I can’t tell you how often it happens. I’m catching up with a friend, and they eventually say: “We’re trying.” It’s usually an exciting moment. Sometimes, I can tell my friends are nervous. Too often, I can tell they’re in pain. It’s hard to believe that in 2024, we’re still fighting to have the right to make some of the most important decisions in our lives. For many of my friends, that has meant the decision to pursue IVF treatments to start their families. It’s a struggle too many families know well. Our nominee for Vice President, Governor Tim Walz, and his wife, Gwen, have experienced it. When I listened to Governor Walz share their story on Tuesday night, I was touched. And then I was angry. Too many Americans can’t access or afford the IVF treatments that could help start their own families. Rather than fight to help people achieve their dreams, politicians like JD Vance want to ban IVF treatments, insulting the millions who struggle with fertility issues each day. = | = I’ve always been a champion of reproductive freedom and abortion rights. That’s why Planned Parenthood Action Fund and Reproductive Freedom for All endorsed me. In November, we can vote and take back our power to make our own health care decisions. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = – Sarah Elfreth * | | = Paid for by Elfreth for Maryland Elfreth for Maryland PO Box 5935 Annapolis, MD 21403 United States

body:
As we approach the two-year anniversary of the PACT Act, I want to take a moment to reflect on its significance and the positive impact it has had. | | | | |
---
| Dear Supporter,
Did you know that Morgan Griffith voted against the PACT Act?
As we approach the two-year anniversary of the PACT Act, I want to take a moment to reflect on its significance and the positive impact it has had on our veterans and their families. This landmark legislation has provided essential healthcare and benefits to veterans exposed to toxic substances during their service. It has been a lifeline for countless individuals, ensuring they receive the care and support they rightfully deserve.
Despite the overwhelming benefits of the PACT Act, Morgan Griffith chose to vote against it. This vote was a vote against our veterans, against the brave men and women who have sacrificed so much for our country. It's a stark reminder of the kind of leadership we have – and the kind we need.
I am committed to standing up for our veterans and ensuring they receive the support they deserve. But I cannot do it alone. I need your help to bring about the change we so desperately need in Southwest Virginia.

Vance is calling Walz’ retirement after 20 years of service a case of “stolen valor” 🙄

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90468707/490611959/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDk4NzhmOTgtYzA1NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AxhhQtkeLKXeCwFkU18xEIbMiS1JD13FhPPlvKaHL3E=&emci=6a083f92-c055-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=09878f98-c055-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Since Kamala Harris selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate, Trump and his MAGA followers have desperately tried to smear him with ridiculous, false attacks.
**Yesterday, JD Vance shot his shot by unearthing a “Swift Boat” style attack on Walz, questioning Walz’s more than two decades of military service.**
The similarities between Vance’s “stolen valor” accusation and the “Swift Boat” campaign that hurt John Kerry in his 2004 campaign against George W. Bush are more than just a coincidence.
[**We’ll explain why in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s efforts to stop right-wing smear tactics in the lead-up to Election Day, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90468708/490611960/-593472309?refcode=20240808-EM-WalzSwiftBoat&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDk4NzhmOTgtYzA1NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AxhhQtkeLKXeCwFkU18xEIbMiS1JD13FhPPlvKaHL3E=)
Vance’s allegation of “stolen valor” stems from Walz’s retirement from the military in 2006. After serving for 24 years, Walz retired to run for Congress because the Department of Defense doesn’t allow military service members to hold public office.
Despite having zero evidence to support such a claim, Vance called Walz’s decades of service “stolen valor garbage,” implying that Walz only retired to avoid going to the Iraq war.
**The attacks are eerily similar to the 2004 Swift Boat attacks on John Kerry. That’s by design. Why? Chris LaCivita is now a senior adviser to the Trump campaign and has been extremely influential for Trump’s 2024 run.**
Predictably, _Fox News_ ran with the attacks last night. They even used the tried and true “Swift Boat” method of bringing on a member of Walz’s former battalion on Jesse Watters’s prime-time show to attack Walz and echo Vance:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90468709/490611962/-593472309?refcode=20240808-EM-WalzSwiftBoat&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDk4NzhmOTgtYzA1NS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AxhhQtkeLKXeCwFkU18xEIbMiS1JD13FhPPlvKaHL3E=)
It’s clear, Peter: the Trump-Vance campaign will do and say anything to win. That includes using Fox News and the far-right media to spread disgraceful lies and smears about Kamala Harris and Tim Walz.
The bad news is that, in the case of the last attempt to “Swift Boat” a candidate, sometimes this kind of slash and burn campaign works.
**But the difference this time is that COURIER is here to fight back by spreading the truth about Harris, Walz, their accomplishments, and their policy proposals to the voters who need to hear it most. As the most consequential election of our lifetimes approaches, we believe it is our democratic duty to be prepared to provide voters with the facts they need to make a decision at the polls.**

If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=aa9eed9148be4019813dfc0c2d18d274&_t=qRZFqbeaAwEtErKetm0UosG_gmc6g_THELaI_5crsiT-sL2M0lSXSkDIE_Eg1cxFC7kAXJC7Gd_PxCCeov0wvx_5B4A-1fQY4Z5C_bB1PxCLbvqfVdmqNPnsj7R_Uxa2)_

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=aa9eed9148be4019813dfc0c2d18d274&_e=BqOtdSepyzCzxP1PaPwU_LWRHSE9hlWSanjEJTx4vS-ao2MD4_UwMTI9vpa-K3JDNafJSxhqC8yvPqA1F-TzfHbg9bY5XBGVB9A2Ca2_qT4f-MyXaDA-JaMQCWlSvbpHZoqSToxdo_Elt7CJFeyCmX2tRQxS-tUftn7_N75LHx8t_DnA0cdppVbF3Ad56bz6DvFs_qhZYndLad6VpQ4D8j1jP6UunTQpvFcFfyJripGXWvP4BVR02y2YI9EhQa27ohuS9HU7hGNnDZZfMHyvv4T7wA8JjrvGoDM3IWo6mhHwANjXs4n_ujr4xHBMBTKB7VG6jyOou7TsV0qKPdFk8CmFCePbFTr0QhuFrcddFc8Ft3J2GkBQkrYF6xmlxEf3)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=aa9eed9148be4019813dfc0c2d18d274&_e=BqOtdSepyzCzxP1PaPwU_LWRHSE9hlWSanjEJTx4vS-ao2MD4_UwMTI9vpa-K3JDNafJSxhqC8yvPqA1F-TzfHbg9bY5XBGVB9A2Ca2_qT4f-MyXaDA-JaMQCWlSvbpHZoqSToxdo_Elt7CJFeyCmX2tRQxS-tUftn7_N75LHx8t_DnA0cdppVbF3Ad56bz6DvFs_qhZYndLad6VpQ4D8h5eMrcEG5ZESGjWOnj6y756Yh733-VcI-n7EBNVBmJw2mOOCVElau65YSQjZN88mtcafFcI77bXK5mSoj3bnC50WPq2CmGzc2VIvCxiNMaZtmS-A3kLI8-j2dYNIrd3Z5gtRqnGq2D0H3QWCx6YoBmmwg7HrHdYqyEo4VV1KLVu)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=aa9eed9148be4019813dfc0c2d18d274&_e=BqOtdSepyzCzxP1PaPwU_LWRHSE9hlWSanjEJTx4vS-ao2MD4_UwMTI9vpa-K3JDNafJSxhqC8yvPqA1F-TzfHbg9bY5XBGVB9A2Ca2_qT4f-MyXaDA-JaMQCWlSvbpHZoqSToxdo_Elt7CJFeyCmX2tRQxS-tUftn7_N75LHx8t_DnA0cdppVbF3Ad56bz6DvFs_qhZYndLad6VpQ4D8grSvsttNb7AQ5BJOPcd6gNADaqfB2CS5VFcVb8-UsbE5J8PZ1HrtAziEd9MnC02lY-zrKf5RJDhinYk8gW-HYB1vmP66KTk3Uzgu3oL7SRMFYw7G3qigwhILIhSjCC2W3-r1qCGZJGVdsGYdrWPCNg9Kj7DiPG0LIjV2t31nx_L) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=aa9eed9148be4019813dfc0c2d18d274&_e=BqOtdSepyzCzxP1PaPwU_LWRHSE9hlWSanjEJTx4vS-ao2MD4_UwMTI9vpa-K3JDNafJSxhqC8yvPqA1F-TzfHbg9bY5XBGVB9A2Ca2_qT4f-MyXaDA-JaMQCWlSvbpHZoqSToxdo_Elt7CJFeyCmX2tRQxS-tUftn7_N75LHx8t_DnA0cdppVbF3Ad56bz6DvFs_qhZYndLad6VpQ4D8mQ656XZN6Bnz2g43C-KiJHzBW1BmoTrKG1WolyngK46ynWosuUMmtTjCnukqtv2kEYyl11SuJ_nrGKSwJzhliy1Bpcl4Og0D3XJh76CfGMTlbw_QqWvz5gNCVzGhvPs-i-OP3TNbQ0qX9n-ZbK_TeF397gKgr0Rd51uV60AC9NG)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**

Previously on '[Hate Mail of the Weak](https://substack.com/redirect/3b5fc644-88b6-4043-9995-e717e13407b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),' I promised to share what happens when you answer a right winger's complaint that "_Spanish and Middle Eastern speaking people are conquering my Columbus suburb_." Yes, that's an actual quote.
I periodically share this more personal side of my advocacy for human rights because it is important to me that you, my gracious supporters, see what I see. Apologies in advance for the harsh language in the screen shots below.
**Let 's Address This **in a new issue of "**Hate Mail of the Weak**."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6479e3f0-79da-4a36-9603-870a97c91936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..MLSOefHJealacj1lqTWVloJXrQ2ZCxF_WM7zvlmvndQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147489998)
It started when a subscriber sent me a video by right wing firebrand Lizzie Marbach, where she claimed "Spanish and Middle Eastern" speaking people were "conquering" her Columbus suburb. Her video had gone viral for all the wrong reasons. They wanted my take on what they felt was a clearly racist video. Marbach, as some might recall, [was fired from an Ohio anti-abortion organization](https://substack.com/redirect/4f5b08d0-5046-448d-9107-87ffd1ebb653?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for being even too right wing for them. She posted her video with this xenophobic caption:
> Am I the only one who's noticed that their neighborhood is being conquered by foreigners? Why are we allowing this to happen? I have 12 generations of ancestors that lived, worked, & been buried on this land. We should not be made to feel out of place in our own homes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0cf6c4a2-8c6e-4954-9b15-99e183ad066d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Clearly inflammatory, and clearly designed to ignite an angry response. Rather than lash out in anger, I posted my comprehensive video response (shared below). My video has so far garnered over 1.7 million views on social media, with more than 300,000 likes and more than 14,000 comments. Needless to say, it went viral for all the right reasons. Take a moment to watch my full video rebutting her anti-immigrant and pro-racist arguments, and let me know what you think. You can watch it on [Instagram here](https://substack.com/redirect/07cc3ff1-02d7-471e-a14b-7ba658516b5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or on [TikTok here](https://substack.com/redirect/8ea36116-ae84-4aa3-8a2e-c4db3bcd6ffa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or just hit play below.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2da2b99c-9b90-4ef8-8cf1-183af95cd793?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..MLSOefHJealacj1lqTWVloJXrQ2ZCxF_WM7zvlmvndQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147489998)
As my video gained popularity, Marbach was not pleased. And unsurprisingly, she immediately doubled down on her racism. In response to my video answering her questions about immigration, she tweeted a screenshot of my Wikipedia profile to highlight that I am a "Pakistani-born American author, activist and attorney." All true, of course, but then she added her caption to explain why she cited my background:
> Sorry, if you don't have a grandparent buried here in America, I don't want to hear your opinion on mass immigration.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2bf83bf-33ec-4cda-97e3-8de58c744e30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Grandfather clauses have of course been a common tool of racists throughout American history to disenfranchise Black and brown Americans from having equal access to justice under the law. It was telling to see Marbach's knee jerk reaction as one to revive a sort of grandfather clause. But perhaps the biggest irony of her attack on me for being an immigrant, is the fact that her European ancestors immigrated to the United States via mass immigration during a policy of actual open borders from Europe. As is well [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/d3226891-f471-4179-8b71-03b2da2a2811?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Between 1820 and 1957, of the approximate 41 million migrants to the US, over 34 million of these came from Europe. The most commonly documented countries of origin during this time were Germany (6.6 million), Italy (4.9 million), Ireland (4.6 million), Great Britain (4.5 million), and Russia (3.4 million).
_Marbach_ is a literal city in Germany. These immigrants required no green cards, no visas, and were subject to no quotas. Instead, many of them benefitted from the Homestead Act, which afforded predominantly European immigrants 270 million acres of land for free--land taken from Indigenous Americans without a cent of reparations.
To be sure, no such mass immigration like that exists today, or has existed since the 1965 Immigration and Naturalization Act. One of the most dangerous lies repeated by Donald Trump, JD Vance, and their MAGA followers is that the 2020 election was stolen.
We heard it every day of the Republican National Convention. We're hearing it at every Trump rally. **And now that Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have picked up enormous speed and enthusiasm, they're turning up the volume.**
Election denialism is still spreading, and if we don't stop it now, it'll warp every election from here on out.
Republican legislators are using denialism to ramp up their attacks on our fundamental right to vote and to obstruct every law that lets us vote quickly and conveniently.
Here's just some of their tricks to keep people at home and out of the voting booths:
* Restricting polling places to create longer lines
* Limiting ballot drop-off boxes
* Purging voter rolls to remove names of less-frequent voters
* Voter ID laws
* Limited or no early voting
* Restrictive voter registration deadlines or no same-day voter registration
* Not allowing college students to vote on their campuses

**Election denialism and voting restrictions are dangerous, and this November is our best chance to put a stop to it.** Like you, we here at Movement Labs are ready to seize our chance, and we're supporting activists and candidates fighting to strengthen our right to vote and make sure everyone has the chance to be heard.
Onward,

And now that Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have picked up enormous speed and enthusiasm, they're turning up the volume. Election denialism is still spreading, and if we don't stop it now, it'll warp every election from here on out. Republican legislators are using denialism to ramp up their attacks on our fundamental right to vote and to obstruct every law that lets us vote quickly and conveniently. Well as Tim Walz put it, 'one mans socialism is another man's neighborliness.' The reason Democrats are in this fight is to do the right thing by the American people, where we see child poverty and hunger, we ask ourselves why and how to fix it. clean_body: In an ultra-competitive presidential election year, our candidates are competing for press, volunteers, ad space, and donors against races at the top of the ticket. | | | | | ---|--- President Obama said it best: State legislators make decisions that impact your life the most – from the roads you drive on, to the lessons taught in our classrooms. name: Chuck Morse
subject: Catching up with Chuck Morse
body:
| | | |
---
**Exclusive Updates and Behind-the-Scenes Snaps from Chuck's Campaign Journey!**
|
---

******I spent over an hour answering questions and sharing my solutions for our Granite State at a town hall hosted by the Seacoast Republicans.**
**Over the past year, I've campaigned the New Hampshire way—traveling across the state, tackling tough questions head-on, and building a strong grassroots coalition.**
**Our efforts are fueling the excitement and activism behind this movement, and we are on track to secure a victory for New Hampshire this fall!**
|
---

**Attending the Suncook Valley Rotary Club's Hot Air Balloon Rally with Senator Pearl was incredible!**
**We enjoyed some great ice cream from my friends at Sub Zero Nitrogen Ice Cream and met dozens of new supporters from around Merrimack County.**
|
---

******I am grateful to have attended a beautiful service at Kingdom Awakening Ministries with Myles and Leza Milham.**
**Their deep faith and love for the community is truly inspiring, and as someone who shares in those values, I feel humbled to have shared in this experience.**
|

Dear Friend,
---
In the shadow of Sacramento’s reckless policies, where leaders turn a blind eye to the homeless, fuel the fire of the drug crisis, and let the housing crisis fester, there is still a light. God has not forgotten California. No, He is moving here, like a quiet wind through the pines. You heard me right.

I love this land, California, and I've seen the strength of the Body of Christ standing firm amidst the storm. That’s why we’ve chosen Los Angeles, a city that knows struggle, to host our album release party. Jim Jordan has officially been scored as the least bipartisan member of the U.S. House of Representatives.

As someone who was born and raised in Ohio and spent summers working on my uncle's farm, I know the value of working hard for people and how to collaborate to get things done—something Jim Jordan simply doesn’t understand.

Instead, he's focused on pushing an extreme ULTRA-MAGA agenda. He doesn’t even work with his colleagues to address the issues that matter most to us.

We need leaders who fight for us, not against us. We need common sense, not extremism.
One of the main reasons I’m running for office is to make our government work for US again. I will work on a bipartisan manner to get things done. I am pleased to tell you that most of the people I have been talking to at the fairs and other community events they all say they’re sick of the division and chaos. They want a working Congress!
I’m telling you, I AM GOING TO WIN!!!

---

Fellow American,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump tomorrow. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 89 days before Election Day.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=7bea08b1e7874357b56d62301e12ba82&_e=QMJnAXQlqgH_VPYKsaYX-pi6FyLIeUUFRCwWBO-FoVMehmUGzuJlWRVgWcnnChde-BweNZaOvhakZCX5OiXg94GYzO0zzXWT1_JOAiaD8uFN5IhFzIjGFWo0vF6VhtoI-V8C3CBeraWW-77Vj0x-RzLCYwqM9xMmZuJw2wtgR9dJ13yL1WdcXWI_dcESk2gLX4cuf3bF2klXsIjoDTBF5n4DRtPgwNSTK_0jeBfFmm5nyj8RInHG-xHPw5N5iu6OFz9pMuonrKP1ieHTSiefb5OH1IlglcMvE5N21pCmRLmebQ3FJiMoO9efj6tJ_fEmriZ4JL1W2nXy2sTenssfm3RgF0zXnT_NJaRbEGChQ1tK531E6_pVmf9ltoiaPcJ8Slb0yreEVrTFx00MoNctOr8YJ0PNc29S6xYOoErTw80%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

body:
Liars and creeps don't belong in the U.S. Senate
| | |
---
Friend,

Let's be real here: Floridians know all too well what creepy is.

**It's Rick Scott. He's a creep. **

It's creepy how intent he is on controlling women's bodily autonomy and reproductive choices. He has pushed time and again for a national abortion ban, and would lead the charge in getting such legislation signed into law if Donald Trump gets reelected to the White House.
It's creepy how he voted against the Right to IVF Act, which would have guaranteed federal protections for the procedure. And it's creepy how he _lied about that vote_ — spending millions of dollars on an ad buy saying he would protect access to that very procedure a day after he voted to do the opposite!
The U.S. Senate is one of our world's greatest democratic bodies. It's not a place for creeps and liars, particularly those like Rick Scott intent on pushing Trump's radical Project 2025 agenda.
**We can and must defeat him: Last time around, Rick Scott spent $64 million of his own money to buy Florida's Senate seat — and he _barely scraped by_ , winning by just over 10,000 votes.**

Look, I'm building coalitions that are much larger than 10,000 votes, and right now, I'm statistically tied with Rick Scott in the polls. But I can't cut my campaign a check for $64 million, nor would I if I could. This is a people-powered movement, and it's _your_ support I need to defeat Rick Scott.

If your inbox is anything like ours, it’s probably pretty full these days.
We understand that it might be tough to see how one contribution could make a difference in one of the most competitive, most expensive Senate races in the country. So we wanted to take a few minutes and explain why $5 really — truly — has a massive impact on our campaign.
Our primary was a little over one week ago. Kari Lake officially became our opponent. Someone who has made threats of political violence towards government employees, who has attacked honorable election workers, who has spread conspiracies and misinformation relentlessly. She calls herself “Trump in heels” and her supporters call her the “MAGA Queen.”
She’s crisscrossing the country, raising tons of cash. She’s got Trump behind her. And she's got outside groups dropping major advertising buys, spending BIG in Arizona against Ruben. And that’s why your support is so important.
According to our records, you haven’t donated to one of these emails. If you chip in to this one, that money will be put to work immediately, reaching voters across Arizona.
We’re talking about staff, television advertisements, radio, digital ads, social media, mail, sending out door knockers, holding town halls, rallies — that’s the stuff your donation goes towards.

As president of our local union, I led the strike.
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90474488/490631629/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTM4NmQ4YS1jZTU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=90mjJ8K4m3ZuuS1HoQMfxReUD6WTSdO53j--Z8jmzFg=&emci=9e364549-ce55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=45386d8a-ce55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=19445147)_
Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90474489/490631631/92586991?refcode=em20240808pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=45386d8a-ce55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTM4NmQ4YS1jZTU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=90mjJ8K4m3ZuuS1HoQMfxReUD6WTSdO53j--Z8jmzFg=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90474490/490631632/92586991?refcode=em20240808pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=45386d8a-ce55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTM4NmQ4YS1jZTU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=90mjJ8K4m3ZuuS1HoQMfxReUD6WTSdO53j--Z8jmzFg=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
Three polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am LEADING her by 2 points.
**I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat.**
**[Please, will you make a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate right now – whatever you can afford – to help me defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate seat in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90474492/490631633/92586991?refcode=em20240808pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=45386d8a-ce55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTM4NmQ4YS1jZTU1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=90mjJ8K4m3ZuuS1HoQMfxReUD6WTSdO53j--Z8jmzFg=)**

clean_body: As president of our local union, I led the strike. Hey there, In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years. I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family. When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after. But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers. So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. = It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class. After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone. It was one of the proudest moments of my life. = Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block. It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me. Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her. Three polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am LEADING her by 2 points. I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I believe we can win this race and keep up the fight for the American middle class. I’m counting on your support to win. Thank you, Dan Osborn ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. | | Friend — It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan. I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down. Because there is just too much at stake: Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class. Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers. Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues. And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history. Hi, Peter,

I just want to take a second to re-introduce myself.

**I’m a Marine Corps veteran, blue-city Republican mayor, husband and father running for Congress in California’s battleground 9th District.**

This is one of the top seats targeted to flip from blue to red in 2024, and it’s a vital part of our strategy to protect and _expand_ our GOP House majority. That’s why **Speaker Mike Johnson** and House Republican leaders are backing my campaign.

In our primary, more voters cast their ballot for a Republican than for my Democrat opponent, Josh Harder.

Now, House Democrats have placed Harder in their **most vulnerable** category – _they know they’re in trouble._

We’re locked in a tight race, and every advantage is needed to pull ahead and flip this seat.

[**All I’m asking is for every patriot reading this to chip in just $5 to send a conservative mayor and Marine to Congress to fix the mess the left has made of America.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5ef47d4af3844a99914dcda795fc7aed&_e=ENIRtupjxYdlBBs4KeJHFTG2cZGEnAY1lQrhaZByxNwTeVqEbuPj2fBjojlh7EHzXQB8eBjT7fcK3Z_6_tvO9Nk_Sb6LrlUB59rhuV_rBUV0jQjLl00QVT1iltvg-ExZ7OLbrHq8gPbFvKgvIbh7vJ93xfBK52Fvm9tceXxGODiJ6ZN9sPPhGpH8pBUx6yZMCdUFlRylSnGZfceHMrnLGtXt9TMql-HSlIfcqiZFFO0zN-i6BKTIDrh1yRP6G3jyzfm3nxEI7Xdl-3oqzHfwwqSRorXPxXQVVOGmyCDTIZOf3YXeY8THs7_kioKn3M7uWugrdpE8zaI4HpJPE7ADgkte6MV99AQzci7jKy-dl-8y7mlF2MImiuNHd8NqMF4y)

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hi! I’m Tara, Tim Kaine’s Virginia Finance Director.
Did you know today is International Cat Day? This is me with my cats, Ada (named after computer science pioneer Ada Lovelace) and Nikola (named after inventor and engineer Nikola Tesla).
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Contrary to what JD Vance thinks, I’m actually not miserable! Nor do I think I deserve less of a voice in our democracy than any other American — unlike Vance.
(Seriously — JD Vance has said in multiple recently resurfaced interviews that he thinks the Democratic Party is being run by “miserable childless cat ladies” and that people without kids have less of a stake in our country and should have less of a voice. Oh, and he thinks we should pay more taxes. Like, what?)
At first glance, those comments are so absurd that they’re funny.
But the thing is, he’s not joking .
And when someone who’s in the running to be our nation’s next Vice President says stuff like this, we have to listen to what he’s really saying. Here’s my best attempt at a translation:
Women have to be married and have kids to be happy and functioning members of our society. We should define who gets to vote based on their parental status. Cats are bad (??!!).
Meanwhile, he’s also trying to take control of how people become parents in the first place, with positions that threaten to limit both IVF and birth control, not to mention other reproductive care.
If you’ve read this far and you agree that we can’t let JD Vance anywhere near the Vice Presidency, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to our campaign here in Virginia. We’re working around the clock to make sure VA’s 13 electoral votes go to Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, not the Trump-Vance ticket — and that we can re-elect Tim Kaine to the U.S. Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=250]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Look, everyone is entitled to their own views. You don’t like cats? Fine! But what you don’t get to do — especially when you’re in the running to lead this country! — is tell the American people that their personal reproductive choices make them less a part of our democracy. That’s just BS.
I’m all in to make sure Tim Walz is our next Vice President, not JD Vance, and I’m so proud that our team here in Virginia is building a massive voter outreach program to mobilize Democrats in every corner of the Commonwealth.
When we vote, we win — so if you can, please chip in to help us reach and turn out more voters! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks so much.
-Tara
Virginia Finance Director, Team Kaine
P.S. Here’s another cat pic, just for good measure...

People like JD Vance are spreading these lies because they know that most Americans don’t have a strong understanding of what Military service looks like. They love the Troops, they respect them, but they wouldn’t know a WARNO from a DD214.
#
Peter —
We’re going to level with you here.
No Veteran who is voting for Kamala Harris or Tim Walz believes the lies that JD Vance and the Trump campaign are trying to tell about Walz and his service in the National Guard.
We’d speculate that no Veteran who is voting AGAINST Kamala Harris or Tim Walz believes the lies that are being told about Walz, either — JD Vance included. They know it’s bullshit.
So, why are they doing it?
People like JD Vance are spreading these lies because they know that most Americans don’t have a strong understanding of what Military service looks like. They love the Troops, they respect them, but they wouldn’t know a WARNO from a DD214. And JD Vance, Trump, and the MAGA-right are spreading these lies to try and take advantage of that.
In short, it’s a cynical political play. They don’t care about insulting countless Veterans who served just as honorably as Tim did. They don’t care about the damage it does to the institution. All they care about is politics.
It’s sad. But we’re not dwelling on that over here at VoteVets. We know the truth, and it’s our job to correct the record. We’re happy to do it, and we’re not alone.

name: Katie Porter
subject: Moms get it done
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
Did you know that there are more millionaires in Congress than there are moms?
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39020%2E3422442%2EyH9rhb)
Dear Derek,
Did you know that there are more millionaires in Congress than there are moms? No wonder Congress prioritizes tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy instead of policies that deliver for our families.
We need our elected officials to look like us and share our experiences, because that’s how we get them to focus on our biggest challenges. That won’t happen unless we make it easier for moms and middle-class Americans to run—and win.
But here’s some good news: We’ve already made progress in getting more moms elected. In 2018, my friend and fellow Congressional candidate Liuba Grechen Shirley convinced our federal election authority to allow—for the first time ever—using campaign funds for childcare. And her leadership also helped me afford childcare during my first House race that same year.
**Derek, it’s pretty simple. Parents, especially moms, can’t successfully campaign if we can’t afford childcare.** For me, running for office as a single mom was hard enough. Without campaign funds for childcare, it would’ve been impossible. That’s why I’ve introduced legislation, the Help America Run Act, which would codify allowing federal candidates to use campaign funds for childcare, so that moms who want to run for office can count on this resource being there.
My friend Liuba launched an organization, Vote Mama, which is working to expand campaign funds for childcare to state and local candidates, so we have more moms representing us at every level of government. Thanks for their efforts, two-thirds of states now allow campaign funds for childcare—but we need to get to 50.
Like Truth to Power, Vote Mama’s mission is to shake up how government works, so that it does better delivering for us. **[Will you split a donation today between Truth to Power and Vote Mama to help us elect more people who will fight for what families need, not what big corporations want?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240808-vm?refcode=em20240808-39020&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39020_3422442_yH9rhb&akid=39020%2E3422442%2EyH9rhb)**
Thank you for your support,
Katie Porter

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240808-39020&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39020_3422442_yH9rhb&akid=39020%2E3422442%2EyH9rhb)**
